### Step 2: Create `llm_core.h` - Quantized Structures (Single-Core)

Simplified header without FreeRTOS dual-core:

```cpp
#ifndef LLM_CORE_H
#define LLM_CORE_H

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SD.h>

// Global group size for quantization (read from model file)
extern int GS;

// Quantized tensor (int8 weights + per-group scales)
typedef struct {
    int8_t* q;    // Quantized int8 values
    float* s;     // Scale factors (one per group_size values)
} QuantizedTensor;

// Model config (read from 256-byte header, adapts to any model size)
typedef struct {
    int dim;
    int hidden_dim;
    int n_layers;
    int n_heads;
    int n_kv_heads;
    int vocab_size;
    int seq_len;
} Config;

// Quantized transformer weights (from runq.c)
typedef struct {
    // Token embeddings - DEQUANTIZED to fp32 at load time
    QuantizedTensor *q_tokens;
    float* token_embedding_table;  // Dequantized copy

    // RMS norms - stored as fp32 (NOT quantized)
    float* rms_att_weight;
    float* rms_ffn_weight;
    float* rms_final_weight;

    // Quantized attention weights (per layer)
    QuantizedTensor *wq;
    QuantizedTensor *wk;
    QuantizedTensor *wv;
    QuantizedTensor *wo;

    // Quantized FFN weights (per layer)
    QuantizedTensor *w1;
    QuantizedTensor *w2;
    QuantizedTensor *w3;

    // Quantized classifier
    QuantizedTensor *wcls;
} TransformerWeights;

// Run state - all sizes allocated dynamically based on Config
typedef struct {
    float *x;       // Current activation (dim)
    float *xb;      // Normalized buffer (dim)
    float *xb2;     // Additional buffer (dim)
    float *hb;      // FFN hidden (hidden_dim)
    float *hb2;     // FFN hidden 2 (hidden_dim)

    // Quantized activation buffers (for matmul input)
    QuantizedTensor xq;  // Quantized x (dim)
    QuantizedTensor hq;  // Quantized hb (hidden_dim)

    float *q;       // Query (dim)
    float *k;       // Key (kv_dim)
    float *v;       // Value (kv_dim)
    float *att;     // Attention scores (n_heads × seq_len)
    float *logits;  // Output logits (vocab_size)

    // KV cache
    float* key_cache;
    float* value_cache;
} RunState;

// Main transformer
typedef struct {
    Config config;
    TransformerWeights weights;
    RunState state;
    uint8_t* raw_data;       // Raw file data in PSRAM
    size_t file_size;
    uint8_t shared_classifier;
} Transformer;

// Quantization functions
void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n);
void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n);

// Core functions
bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path);
void free_transformer(Transformer* t);

// Neural net operations
void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size);
void softmax(float* x, int size);
void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d);

// Forward pass
float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos);

#endif
```

### Step 3: Create `llm_core.cpp` - Int8 Inference (Single-Core)

Key sections to implement:

#### A. Quantization Functions (from runq.c)

```cpp
int GS = 64;  // Global group size (read from model header)

void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
    }
}

void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    int num_groups = n / GS;
    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;

    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
        // Find max absolute value in group
        float wmax = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
            float val = fabsf(x[group * GS + i]);
            if (val > wmax) wmax = val;
        }

        // Scale factor
        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
        qx->s[group] = scale;

        // Quantize
        float inv_scale = (scale != 0.0f) ? 1.0f / scale : 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
            float quant_value = x[group * GS + i] * inv_scale;
            qx->q[group * GS + i] = (int8_t)roundf(quant_value);
        }
    }
}
```

#### B. Int8 Matrix Multiplication (Single-Core, from runq.c)

```cpp
// Simple single-threaded int8 matmul
// W (d,n) @ x (n,) -> xout (d,)
void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
        float val = 0.0f;
        int32_t ival = 0;
        int in = i * n;

        // Process in groups of GS (group size)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
            // Accumulate int8 × int8 in int32 (no overflow risk)
            for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
                ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
            }
            // Rescale after each group using float scales
            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
            ival = 0;
        }
        xout[i] = val;
    }
}
```

#### C. Checkpoint Loading (Version 2 Format, Adaptive to Any Model Size)

```cpp
bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path) {
    File file = SD.open(checkpoint_path, FILE_READ);
    if (!file) return false;

    // Read 256-byte header
    uint32_t magic, version;
    file.read((uint8_t*)&magic, 4);
    file.read((uint8_t*)&version, 4);

    if (magic != 0x616b3432 || version != 2) {
        Serial.println("Invalid Q8_0 model (need magic=0x616b3432, version=2)");
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    // Read config (adapts to any model size automatically)
    file.read((uint8_t*)&t->config, sizeof(Config));

    // Read shared_classifier flag and group_size
    file.read(&t->shared_classifier, 1);
    file.read((uint8_t*)&GS, 4);

    // Print loaded config (shows any model size works)
    Serial.printf("Model loaded: dim=%d, hidden=%d, layers=%d, heads=%d, vocab=%d, GS=%d\n",
                  t->config.dim, t->config.hidden_dim, t->config.n_layers,
                  t->config.n_heads, t->config.vocab_size, GS);

    // Load entire file to PSRAM
    t->file_size = file.size();
    t->raw_data = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(t->file_size);
    if (!t->raw_data) {
        Serial.printf("PSRAM allocation failed! Need %zu bytes\n", t->file_size);
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    file.seek(0);
    file.read(t->raw_data, t->file_size);
    file.close();

    Serial.printf("Model file loaded: %.2f MB\n", t->file_size / (1024.0f * 1024.0f));

    // Memory map weights starting after 256-byte header
    memory_map_weights_q8(&t->weights, &t->config, t->raw_data + 256, t->shared_classifier);

    // Dequantize token embeddings once (size adapts to vocab_size × dim)
    int emb_size = t->config.vocab_size * t->config.dim;
    t->weights.token_embedding_table = (float*)ps_malloc(emb_size * sizeof(float));
    if (!t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
        Serial.println("Embedding dequant allocation failed!");
        return false;
    }
    dequantize(t->weights.q_tokens, t->weights.token_embedding_table, emb_size);

    // Allocate run state (sizes based on config, adapts to any model)
    malloc_run_state_q8(&t->state, &t->config);

    Serial.printf("Free PSRAM after load: %d bytes\n", ESP.getFreePsram());
    return true;
}
```

#### D. Forward Pass (from runq.c pattern)

```cpp
float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos) {
    Config* p = &transformer->config;
    TransformerWeights* w = &transformer->weights;
    RunState* s = &transformer->state;

    int dim = p->dim;
    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;

    // Copy token embedding (already dequantized)
    memcpy(s->x, w->token_embedding_table + token * dim, dim * sizeof(float));

    // Forward through layers
    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
        // Attention RMSnorm
        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);

        // Quantize activation, then matmul for Q, K, V
        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);

        // RoPE
        // ... (same as stories15m)

        // Attention
        // ... (same as stories15m, uses fp32 KV cache)

        // Output projection
        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);

        // Residual
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) s->x[i] += s->xb2[i];

        // FFN RMSnorm
        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);

        // FFN w1, w3
        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);

        // SwiGLU
        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i++) {
            float val = s->hb[i];
            val *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-val));
            s->hb[i] = val * s->hb2[i];
        }

        // FFN w2
        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->xb, &s->hq, &w->w2[l], hidden_dim, dim);

        // Residual
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) s->x[i] += s->xb[i];
    }

    // Final RMSnorm
    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);

    // Classifier
    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);

    return s->logits;
}
```

### Step 4: Create Main Sketch with SD Card + JSON Config + Prompt Wrapping

```cpp
#include <SD.h>
#include <SPI.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>
#include "llm_core.h"
#include "tokenizer.h"
#include "sampler.h"

#define SD_CS   41

// Config structure
struct LLMConfig {
    char model_path[64];
    char tokenizer_path[64];
    float temperature;
    float topp;
    int max_tokens;
};

LLMConfig config;
Transformer transformer;
Tokenizer tokenizer;
Sampler sampler;

bool loadConfig(const char* path) {
    File f = SD.open(path);
    if (!f) return false;

    StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
    if (deserializeJson(doc, f)) {
        f.close();
        return false;
    }
    f.close();

    strlcpy(config.model_path, doc["model"] | "/models/ajv009_3M_1024TK_q80.bin", 64);
    strlcpy(config.tokenizer_path, doc["tokenizer"] | "/models/ajv009_1024TK.bin", 64);
    config.temperature = doc["temperature"] | 0.8f;
    config.topp = doc["topp"] | 0.9f;
    config.max_tokens = doc["max_tokens"] | 128;

    return true;
}

String wrapPrompt(const char* userInput) {
    return String("<|user|>") + userInput + "<|assistant|>";
}

void generate(const char* prompt, int steps) {
    // Wrap prompt with special tokens
    String wrapped = wrapPrompt(prompt);

    // Encode
    int* tokens = (int*)malloc((wrapped.length() + 10) * sizeof(int));
    int num_tokens = 0;
    encode(&tokenizer, (char*)wrapped.c_str(), 0, 0, tokens, &num_tokens);

    // Generate
    int token = tokens[0];
    int pos = 0;

    while (pos < steps) {
        float* logits = forward(&transformer, token, pos);
        if (!logits) break;

        int next;
        if (pos < num_tokens - 1) {
            next = tokens[pos + 1];
        } else {
            next = sample(&sampler, logits);
        }
        pos++;

        // Decode and print
        char* piece = decode(&tokenizer, token, next);
        if (piece) {
            // Check for end token
            if (strstr(piece, "<|end|>")) break;
            Serial.print(piece);
        }

        token = next;
    }

    free(tokens);
}

void setup() {
    Serial.begin(115200);
    delay(1000);

    Serial.println("\n=== ESP32 Fine-tuned LLM (Q8_0) ===\n");

    // Init SD
    SPI.begin(39, 40, 38, SD_CS);
    if (!SD.begin(SD_CS)) {
        Serial.println("SD card failed!");
        return;
    }

    // Load config
    if (!loadConfig("/models/config.json")) {
        Serial.println("Using default config");
    }

    // Load model
    Serial.printf("Loading model: %s\n", config.model_path);
    if (!build_transformer_q8(&transformer, config.model_path)) {
        Serial.println("Model load failed!");
        return;
    }

    // Load tokenizer
    if (!build_tokenizer(&tokenizer, config.tokenizer_path, transformer.config.vocab_size)) {
        Serial.println("Tokenizer load failed!");
        return;
    }

    // Build sampler
    build_sampler(&sampler, transformer.config.vocab_size,
                  config.temperature, config.topp, millis());

    Serial.println("\nReady! Type your question:");
}

void loop() {
    if (Serial.available()) {
        String input = Serial.readStringUntil('\n');
        input.trim();
        if (input.length() > 0) {
            Serial.printf("\nQ: %s\nA: ", input.c_str());
            generate(input.c_str(), config.max_tokens);
            Serial.println("\n");
        }
    }
}
```

## Memory Budget (Various Model Sizes)

All models fit in 8MB PSRAM:

| Model | File Size | + Embeddings | + KV Cache | + Buffers | **Total** |
|-------|-----------|--------------|------------|-----------|-----------|
| 1M q80 | ~1 MB | ~250 KB | ~130 KB | ~50 KB | **~1.5 MB** |
| 2M q80 | ~2 MB | ~490 KB | ~200 KB | ~80 KB | **~2.8 MB** |
| 3M q80 | ~3 MB | ~700 KB | ~280 KB | ~100 KB | **~4.1 MB** |
| 4M q80 | ~4 MB | ~750 KB | ~300 KB | ~110 KB | **~5.2 MB** |
| 5M q80 | ~5 MB | ~850 KB | ~360 KB | ~130 KB | **~6.4 MB** |
| 6M q80 | ~6 MB | ~920 KB | ~450 KB | ~150 KB | **~7.5 MB** |

**Conclusion**: Even 6M model fits with ~500KB headroom!

```h
// llm_core.h - Int8 Quantized LLM Inference for ESP32-S3
// Based on llama2.c/runq.c - Single-core, adaptive to any model size
// Supports 1M-6M models with 512/768/1024 vocab sizes

#ifndef LLM_CORE_H
#define LLM_CORE_H

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SD.h>

// Global group size for quantization (read from model file header)
extern int GS;

// Quantized tensor (int8 weights + per-group float scales)
typedef struct {
    int8_t* q;    // Quantized int8 values
    float* s;     // Scale factors (one per group_size values)
} QuantizedTensor;

// Model config (read from 256-byte Q8_0 header, adapts to any model size)
typedef struct {
    int dim;        // Model dimension (128-224 for 1M-6M)
    int hidden_dim; // FFN hidden size (512-896)
    int n_layers;   // Number of transformer layers (4-8)
    int n_heads;    // Number of attention heads (8)
    int n_kv_heads; // Number of KV heads for GQA (4)
    int vocab_size; // Vocabulary size (512, 768, or 1024)
    int seq_len;    // Max sequence length (256)
} Config;

// Quantized transformer weights (from runq.c pattern)
typedef struct {
    // Token embeddings - DEQUANTIZED to fp32 at load time for fast lookup
    QuantizedTensor *q_tokens;
    float* token_embedding_table;  // Dequantized copy

    // RMS norms - stored as fp32 in model file (NOT quantized)
    float* rms_att_weight;   // Per-layer attention norm
    float* rms_ffn_weight;   // Per-layer FFN norm
    float* rms_final_weight; // Final norm before classifier

    // Quantized attention weights (array of QuantizedTensor, one per layer)
    QuantizedTensor *wq;  // Query projection
    QuantizedTensor *wk;  // Key projection
    QuantizedTensor *wv;  // Value projection
    QuantizedTensor *wo;  // Output projection

    // Quantized FFN weights (array of QuantizedTensor, one per layer)
    QuantizedTensor *w1;  // Gate projection
    QuantizedTensor *w2;  // Down projection
    QuantizedTensor *w3;  // Up projection

    // Quantized classifier (may share with q_tokens if shared_classifier=1)
    QuantizedTensor *wcls;
} TransformerWeights;

// Run state - activation buffers, all sizes allocated dynamically based on Config
typedef struct {
    float *x;       // Current activation (dim)
    float *xb;      // Normalized buffer (dim)
    float *xb2;     // Additional buffer (dim)
    float *hb;      // FFN hidden state (hidden_dim)
    float *hb2;     // FFN hidden state 2 (hidden_dim)

    // Quantized activation buffers (for matmul input)
    QuantizedTensor xq;  // Quantized x (dim)
    QuantizedTensor hq;  // Quantized hb (hidden_dim)

    float *q;       // Query vector (dim)
    float *k;       // Key vector (kv_dim)
    float *v;       // Value vector (kv_dim)
    float *att;     // Attention scores (n_heads * seq_len)
    float *logits;  // Output logits (vocab_size)

    // KV cache for autoregressive generation
    float* key_cache;   // (n_layers * seq_len * kv_dim)
    float* value_cache; // (n_layers * seq_len * kv_dim)
} RunState;

// Main transformer structure
typedef struct {
    Config config;
    TransformerWeights weights;
    RunState state;
    uint8_t* raw_data;       // Raw model file data in PSRAM
    size_t file_size;
    uint8_t shared_classifier; // 1 if wcls shares memory with q_tokens
} Transformer;

// ============================================================================
// Quantization functions
// ============================================================================

// Dequantize int8 tensor to float (used once for token embeddings at load)
void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n);

// Quantize float activation to int8 (used before each matmul)
void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n);

// ============================================================================
// Core functions
// ============================================================================

// Build transformer from Q8_0 model file on SD card
// Reads config from header, adapts to any model size
bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path);

// Free all allocated memory
void free_transformer(Transformer* t);

// ============================================================================
// Neural network operations
// ============================================================================

// RMS normalization
void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size);

// Softmax (in-place)
void softmax(float* x, int size);

// Int8 quantized matrix multiplication: W (d,n) @ x (n,) -> xout (d,)
// Both x and w are quantized, output is float
void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d);

// ============================================================================
// Forward pass
// ============================================================================

// Run single token through transformer, returns logits (vocab_size)
// token: input token ID
// pos: position in sequence (for RoPE and KV cache)
float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos);

#endif // LLM_CORE_H
```

```cpp
// llm_core.cpp - Int8 Quantized LLM Inference for ESP32-S3
// Based on llama2.c/runq.c - Single-core, adaptive to any model size

#include "llm_core.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

// Global group size (read from model header, typically 64)
int GS = 64;

// ============================================================================
// Quantization Functions (from runq.c)
// ============================================================================

void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
    }
}

void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    int num_groups = n / GS;
    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;

    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
        // Find max absolute value in current group
        float wmax = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
            float val = fabsf(x[group * GS + i]);
            if (val > wmax) wmax = val;
        }

        // Calculate and store scale factor
        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
        qx->s[group] = scale;

        // Quantize values in this group
        float inv_scale = (scale != 0.0f) ? 1.0f / scale : 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
            float quant_value = x[group * GS + i] * inv_scale;
            qx->q[group * GS + i] = (int8_t)roundf(quant_value);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Neural Network Operations
// ============================================================================

void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size) {
    // Calculate sum of squares
    float ss = 0.0f;
    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
        ss += x[j] * x[j];
    }
    ss /= size;
    ss += 1e-5f;
    ss = 1.0f / sqrtf(ss);

    // Normalize and scale
    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
        o[j] = weight[j] * (ss * x[j]);
    }
}

void softmax(float* x, int size) {
    // Find max value for numerical stability
    float max_val = x[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
        if (x[i] > max_val) max_val = x[i];
    }

    // Exp and sum
    float sum = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        x[i] = expf(x[i] - max_val);
        sum += x[i];
    }

    // Normalize
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        x[i] /= sum;
    }
}

// Int8 quantized matrix multiplication (single-threaded)
// W (d,n) @ x (n,) -> xout (d,)
void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
        float val = 0.0f;
        int32_t ival = 0;
        int in = i * n;

        // Process in groups of GS
        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
            // Accumulate int8 * int8 in int32 (no overflow risk)
            for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
                ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
            }
            // Rescale after each group using float scales
            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
            ival = 0;
        }
        xout[i] = val;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Memory Allocation
// ============================================================================

static void malloc_run_state(RunState* s, Config* p) {
    int kv_dim = (p->dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;

    // Float activation buffers in PSRAM
    s->x = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->xb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->xb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->hb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->hb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->q = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->att = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_heads * p->seq_len, sizeof(float));
    s->logits = (float*)ps_calloc(p->vocab_size, sizeof(float));

    // KV cache in PSRAM
    s->key_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->value_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));

    // Quantized activation buffers (for matmul input)
    s->xq.q = (int8_t*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(int8_t));
    s->xq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim / GS, sizeof(float));
    s->hq.q = (int8_t*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(int8_t));
    s->hq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim / GS, sizeof(float));

    // Check allocations
    if (!s->x || !s->xb || !s->xb2 || !s->hb || !s->hb2 || !s->q ||
        !s->att || !s->logits || !s->key_cache || !s->value_cache ||
        !s->xq.q || !s->xq.s || !s->hq.q || !s->hq.s) {
        Serial.println("ERROR: RunState allocation failed!");
    }
}

static void free_run_state(RunState* s) {
    free(s->x);
    free(s->xb);
    free(s->xb2);
    free(s->hb);
    free(s->hb2);
    free(s->q);
    free(s->att);
    free(s->logits);
    free(s->key_cache);
    free(s->value_cache);
    free(s->xq.q);
    free(s->xq.s);
    free(s->hq.q);
    free(s->hq.s);
}

// ============================================================================
// Weight Memory Mapping (Q8_0 Format)
// ============================================================================

// Initialize n quantized tensors from memory pointer
static QuantizedTensor* init_quantized_tensors(void** ptr, int n, int size_each) {
    void* p = *ptr;
    QuantizedTensor* res = (QuantizedTensor*)malloc(n * sizeof(QuantizedTensor));

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // Map quantized int8 values
        res[i].q = (int8_t*)p;
        p = (int8_t*)p + size_each;

        // Map scale factors (one per group)
        res[i].s = (float*)p;
        p = (float*)p + size_each / GS;
    }

    *ptr = p;  // Advance pointer
    return res;
}

static void memory_map_weights(TransformerWeights* w, Config* p, void* ptr, uint8_t shared_classifier) {
    int head_size = p->dim / p->n_heads;

    // First: fp32 RMS norm weights (NOT quantized)
    float* fptr = (float*)ptr;
    w->rms_att_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
    w->rms_ffn_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
    w->rms_final_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->dim;

    // Now quantized weights
    ptr = (void*)fptr;

    // Token embeddings (quantized, will be dequantized separately)
    w->q_tokens = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->vocab_size * p->dim);

    // Attention weights per layer
    w->wq = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_heads * head_size));
    w->wk = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
    w->wv = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
    w->wo = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, (p->n_heads * head_size) * p->dim);

    // FFN weights per layer
    w->w1 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
    w->w2 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->hidden_dim * p->dim);
    w->w3 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);

    // Classifier (shared or separate)
    w->wcls = shared_classifier ? w->q_tokens : init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->dim * p->vocab_size);
}

// ============================================================================
// Transformer Build/Free
// ============================================================================

bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path) {
    File file = SD.open(checkpoint_path, FILE_READ);
    if (!file) {
        Serial.printf("Failed to open model: %s\n", checkpoint_path);
        return false;
    }

    // Read 256-byte header
    uint32_t magic, version;
    file.read((uint8_t*)&magic, 4);
    file.read((uint8_t*)&version, 4);

    // Validate Q8_0 format
    if (magic != 0x616b3432) {
        Serial.printf("Invalid magic: 0x%08X (expected 0x616b3432)\n", magic);
        file.close();
        return false;
    }
    if (version != 2) {
        Serial.printf("Invalid version: %d (expected 2 for Q8_0)\n", version);
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    // Read config (adapts to any model size)
    file.read((uint8_t*)&t->config, sizeof(Config));

    // Read shared_classifier flag and group_size
    file.read(&t->shared_classifier, 1);
    file.read((uint8_t*)&GS, 4);

    // Print loaded config
    Serial.printf("Q8_0 Model loaded:\n");
    Serial.printf("  dim=%d, hidden=%d, layers=%d\n",
                  t->config.dim, t->config.hidden_dim, t->config.n_layers);
    Serial.printf("  heads=%d, kv_heads=%d, vocab=%d, seq=%d\n",
                  t->config.n_heads, t->config.n_kv_heads,
                  t->config.vocab_size, t->config.seq_len);
    Serial.printf("  group_size=%d, shared_cls=%d\n", GS, t->shared_classifier);

    // Load entire file to PSRAM
    t->file_size = file.size();
    t->raw_data = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(t->file_size);
    if (!t->raw_data) {
        Serial.printf("PSRAM allocation failed! Need %zu bytes\n", t->file_size);
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    file.seek(0);
    size_t bytes_read = file.read(t->raw_data, t->file_size);
    file.close();

    if (bytes_read != t->file_size) {
        Serial.printf("Read error: %zu / %zu bytes\n", bytes_read, t->file_size);
        free(t->raw_data);
        return false;
    }

    Serial.printf("  File loaded: %.2f MB\n", t->file_size / (1024.0f * 1024.0f));

    // Memory map weights starting after 256-byte header
    memory_map_weights(&t->weights, &t->config, t->raw_data + 256, t->shared_classifier);

    // Dequantize token embeddings once (for fast lookup during inference)
    int emb_size = t->config.vocab_size * t->config.dim;
    t->weights.token_embedding_table = (float*)ps_malloc(emb_size * sizeof(float));
    if (!t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
        Serial.println("Embedding allocation failed!");
        free(t->raw_data);
        return false;
    }
    dequantize(t->weights.q_tokens, t->weights.token_embedding_table, emb_size);

    Serial.printf("  Embeddings dequantized: %.2f KB\n", emb_size * sizeof(float) / 1024.0f);

    // Allocate run state (sizes based on config)
    malloc_run_state(&t->state, &t->config);

    Serial.printf("  Free PSRAM: %d bytes\n", ESP.getFreePsram());
    Serial.println("Transformer ready!");

    return true;
}

void free_transformer(Transformer* t) {
    if (t->raw_data) {
        free(t->raw_data);
        t->raw_data = nullptr;
    }
    if (t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
        free(t->weights.token_embedding_table);
        t->weights.token_embedding_table = nullptr;
    }

    // Free QuantizedTensor arrays
    free(t->weights.q_tokens);
    free(t->weights.wq);
    free(t->weights.wk);
    free(t->weights.wv);
    free(t->weights.wo);
    free(t->weights.w1);
    free(t->weights.w2);
    free(t->weights.w3);
    if (!t->shared_classifier) {
        free(t->weights.wcls);
    }

    free_run_state(&t->state);
}

// ============================================================================
// Forward Pass
// ============================================================================

float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos) {
    Config* p = &transformer->config;
    TransformerWeights* w = &transformer->weights;
    RunState* s = &transformer->state;

    // Convenience variables
    int dim = p->dim;
    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
    int kv_mul = p->n_heads / p->n_kv_heads;
    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;

    // Copy token embedding into x (already dequantized)
    float* content_row = w->token_embedding_table + token * dim;
    memcpy(s->x, content_row, dim * sizeof(float));

    // Forward through all layers
    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
        // Attention RMSnorm
        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);

        // QKV matmuls
        int loff = l * p->seq_len * kv_dim;  // KV cache offset for this layer
        s->k = s->key_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
        s->v = s->value_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;

        // Quantize activation, then compute Q, K, V
        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);

        // RoPE positional encoding
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i += 2) {
            int head_dim = i % head_size;
            float freq = 1.0f / powf(10000.0f, head_dim / (float)head_size);
            float val = pos * freq;
            float fcr = cosf(val);
            float fci = sinf(val);
            int rotn = i < kv_dim ? 2 : 1;
            for (int v = 0; v < rotn; v++) {
                float* vec = v == 0 ? s->q : s->k;
                float v0 = vec[i];
                float v1 = vec[i + 1];
                vec[i] = v0 * fcr - v1 * fci;
                vec[i + 1] = v0 * fci + v1 * fcr;
            }
        }

        // Multi-head attention
        for (int h = 0; h < p->n_heads; h++) {
            float* q = s->q + h * head_size;
            float* att = s->att + h * p->seq_len;

            // Attention scores
            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
                float* k = s->key_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
                float score = 0.0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
                    score += q[i] * k[i];
                }
                att[t] = score / sqrtf(head_size);
            }

            // Softmax attention weights
            softmax(att, pos + 1);

            // Weighted sum of values
            float* xb = s->xb + h * head_size;
            memset(xb, 0, head_size * sizeof(float));
            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
                float* v = s->value_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
                float a = att[t];
                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
                    xb[i] += a * v[i];
                }
            }
        }

        // Output projection
        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);

        // Residual connection
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            s->x[i] += s->xb2[i];
        }

        // FFN RMSnorm
        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);

        // FFN: w1 and w3 in parallel, then SwiGLU, then w2
        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);

        // SwiGLU activation
        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i++) {
            float val = s->hb[i];
            val *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-val));  // silu(x) = x * sigmoid(x)
            s->hb[i] = val * s->hb2[i];
        }

        // Down projection
        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->xb, &s->hq, &w->w2[l], hidden_dim, dim);

        // Residual connection
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            s->x[i] += s->xb[i];
        }
    }

    // Final RMSnorm
    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);

    // Classifier into logits
    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);

    return s->logits;
}
```

```ino
// 05_llm_finetuned.ino - Fine-tuned Q8_0 LLM Inference
// Supports multiple model sizes (1M-6M) with switchable config
// SD card loading, JSON config, auto-wrap prompts with Q&A tokens

#include <SD.h>
#include <SPI.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>
#include "llm_core.h"
#include "tokenizer.h"
#include "sampler.h"

// SD card SPI pins (shared with LCD)
#define SD_CS   41
#define SD_MOSI 38
#define SD_MISO 40
#define SD_SCK  39

// Config file path
#define CONFIG_PATH "/models/config.json"

// Default values if config missing
#define DEFAULT_MODEL      "/models/ajv009_3M_1024TK_q80.bin"
#define DEFAULT_TOKENIZER  "/models/ajv009_1024TK.bin"
#define DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE 0.8f
#define DEFAULT_TOPP       0.9f
#define DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS 128

// Runtime config structure
struct LLMConfig {
    char model_path[64];
    char tokenizer_path[64];
    float temperature;
    float topp;
    int max_tokens;
};

// Global instances
LLMConfig config;
Transformer transformer;
Tokenizer tokenizer;
Sampler sampler;
bool model_loaded = false;

// ============================================================================
// Config Loading
// ============================================================================

bool loadConfig(const char* path) {
    File f = SD.open(path);
    if (!f) {
        Serial.printf("Config not found: %s\n", path);
        return false;
    }

    StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
    DeserializationError err = deserializeJson(doc, f);
    f.close();

    if (err) {
        Serial.printf("JSON parse error: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return false;
    }

    // Read with defaults
    strlcpy(config.model_path, doc["model"] | DEFAULT_MODEL, sizeof(config.model_path));
    strlcpy(config.tokenizer_path, doc["tokenizer"] | DEFAULT_TOKENIZER, sizeof(config.tokenizer_path));
    config.temperature = doc["temperature"] | DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE;
    config.topp = doc["topp"] | DEFAULT_TOPP;
    config.max_tokens = doc["max_tokens"] | DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS;

    Serial.println("Config loaded:");
    Serial.printf("  model: %s\n", config.model_path);
    Serial.printf("  tokenizer: %s\n", config.tokenizer_path);
    Serial.printf("  temp=%.2f, topp=%.2f, max_tokens=%d\n",
                  config.temperature, config.topp, config.max_tokens);

    return true;
}

void setDefaultConfig() {
    strlcpy(config.model_path, DEFAULT_MODEL, sizeof(config.model_path));
    strlcpy(config.tokenizer_path, DEFAULT_TOKENIZER, sizeof(config.tokenizer_path));
    config.temperature = DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE;
    config.topp = DEFAULT_TOPP;
    config.max_tokens = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS;

    Serial.println("Using default config");
}

// ============================================================================
// Prompt Wrapping
// ============================================================================

// Wrap user input with Q&A special tokens
String wrapPrompt(const char* userInput) {
    return String("<|user|>") + userInput + "<|assistant|>";
}

// Check if token piece contains end marker
bool isEndToken(const char* piece) {
    return piece && strstr(piece, "<|end|>") != nullptr;
}

// ============================================================================
// Generation
// ============================================================================

void generate(const char* prompt, int steps) {
    // Wrap prompt with special tokens
    String wrapped = wrapPrompt(prompt);

    // Allocate token buffer (prompt length + some extra)
    int max_prompt_tokens = wrapped.length() + 10;
    int* prompt_tokens = (int*)malloc(max_prompt_tokens * sizeof(int));
    if (!prompt_tokens) {
        Serial.println("Token buffer allocation failed!");
        return;
    }

    // Encode wrapped prompt
    int num_prompt_tokens = 0;
    encode(&tokenizer, (char*)wrapped.c_str(), 0, 0, prompt_tokens, &num_prompt_tokens);

    if (num_prompt_tokens < 1) {
        Serial.println("Encoding failed!");
        free(prompt_tokens);
        return;
    }

    // Generation loop
    unsigned long start_time = 0;
    int token = prompt_tokens[0];
    int pos = 0;
    int generated = 0;

    while (pos < steps) {
        // Forward pass
        float* logits = forward(&transformer, token, pos);
        if (!logits) {
            Serial.println("\nForward pass failed!");
            break;
        }

        // Get next token
        int next;
        if (pos < num_prompt_tokens - 1) {
            // Still processing prompt
            next = prompt_tokens[pos + 1];
        } else {
            // Sample from logits
            next = sample(&sampler, logits);
            generated++;
        }
        pos++;

        // Decode and print token
        char* piece = decode(&tokenizer, token, next);
        if (piece && piece[0] != '\0') {
            // Check for end token
            if (isEndToken(piece)) {
                break;
            }

            // Print token (filter control characters)
            if (piece[1] == '\0') {
                unsigned char byte_val = piece[0];
                if (isprint(byte_val) || isspace(byte_val)) {
                    Serial.print(piece);
                }
            } else {
                Serial.print(piece);
            }
        }

        token = next;

        // Start timer after prompt processing
        if (start_time == 0 && pos >= num_prompt_tokens) {
            start_time = millis();
        }
    }

    // Print performance stats
    if (generated > 0 && start_time > 0) {
        unsigned long elapsed = millis() - start_time;
        float tokens_per_sec = (float)generated / (elapsed / 1000.0f);
        Serial.printf("\n\n[%d tokens, %.1f tok/s]\n", generated, tokens_per_sec);
    }

    free(prompt_tokens);
}

// ============================================================================
// Setup
// ============================================================================

void setup() {
    Serial.begin(115200);
    delay(1000);

    Serial.println("\n========================================");
    Serial.println("ESP32 Fine-tuned LLM (Q8_0)");
    Serial.println("========================================\n");

    // Memory info
    Serial.printf("Total PSRAM: %d bytes\n", ESP.getPsramSize());
    Serial.printf("Free PSRAM: %d bytes\n", ESP.getFreePsram());
    Serial.println();

    // Initialize SD card
    Serial.print("Mounting SD card... ");
    SPI.begin(SD_SCK, SD_MISO, SD_MOSI, SD_CS);
    if (!SD.begin(SD_CS)) {
        Serial.println("FAILED!");
        Serial.println("Please insert SD card with model files.");
        return;
    }
    Serial.println("OK");

    uint64_t cardSize = SD.cardSize() / (1024 * 1024);
    Serial.printf("SD Card Size: %llu MB\n\n", cardSize);

    // Load config (or use defaults)
    if (!loadConfig(CONFIG_PATH)) {
        setDefaultConfig();
    }
    Serial.println();

    // Load model
    Serial.printf("Loading model: %s\n", config.model_path);
    if (!build_transformer_q8(&transformer, config.model_path)) {
        Serial.println("Model load FAILED!");
        Serial.println("Check that model file exists on SD card.");
        return;
    }
    Serial.println();

    // Load tokenizer
    Serial.printf("Loading tokenizer: %s\n", config.tokenizer_path);
    if (!build_tokenizer(&tokenizer, config.tokenizer_path, transformer.config.vocab_size)) {
        Serial.println("Tokenizer load FAILED!");
        return;
    }
    Serial.println("Tokenizer loaded\n");

    // Build sampler
    unsigned long long seed = millis();
    build_sampler(&sampler, transformer.config.vocab_size,
                  config.temperature, config.topp, seed);

    // Ready
    model_loaded = true;

    Serial.printf("Memory after load:\n");
    Serial.printf("  Free PSRAM: %d bytes\n", ESP.getFreePsram());
    Serial.printf("  Free Heap: %d bytes\n\n", ESP.getFreeHeap());

    Serial.println("========================================");
    Serial.println("Ready! Type your question and press Enter");
    Serial.println("========================================\n");
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Loop
// ============================================================================

void loop() {
    if (!model_loaded) {
        delay(1000);
        return;
    }

    if (Serial.available()) {
        String input = Serial.readStringUntil('\n');
        input.trim();

        if (input.length() == 0) {
            return;
        }

        Serial.printf("\nQ: %s\n", input.c_str());
        Serial.print("A: ");

        generate(input.c_str(), config.max_tokens);

        Serial.println("\n----------------------------------------\n");
    }
}

```

     ```cpp
     void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
         for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
             float val = 0.0f;
             int32_t ival = 0;
             int in = i * n;
             for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
                 for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
                     ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
                 }
                 val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
                 ival = 0;
             }
             xout[i] = val;
         }
     }
     ```

    20→From training notebook, these model sizes are supported:
    21→
    22→| Size | dim | hidden_dim | n_layers | n_heads | n_kv_heads |
    23→|------|-----|------------|----------|---------|------------|
    24→| 1M   | 128 | 512        | 4        | 8       | 4          |
    25→| 2M   | 160 | 640        | 5        | 8       | 4          |
    26→| 3M   | 176 | 704        | 6        | 8       | 4          |
    27→| 4M   | 192 | 768        | 6        | 8       | 4          |
    28→| 5M   | 208 | 832        | 7        | 8       | 4          |
    29→| 6M   | 224 | 896        | 8        | 8       | 4          |
    30→
    31→Vocab sizes: **512, 768, 1024** tokens
    32→
    33→File naming: `ajv009_{SIZE}M_{VOCAB}TK_q80.bin` (e.g., `ajv009_3M_1024TK_q80.bin`)
    34→
    35→## Q8_0 Binary Format (Version 2)
    36→
    37→From llama2.c/runq.c - our models use this exact format:
    38→
    39→```
    40→Header (256 bytes):
    41→├── magic: uint32 = 0x616b3432 ("ak42")
    42→├── version: uint32 = 2
    43→├── Config: dim, hidden_dim, n_layers, n_heads, n_kv_heads, vocab_size, seq_len
    44→├── shared_classifier: uint8
    45→├── group_size: int (typically 64)
    46→└── padding to 256 bytes
    47→
    48→Data (fp32 RMS norms first, then quantized weights):
    49→├── rms_att_weight: n_layers × dim floats
    50→├── rms_ffn_weight: n_layers × dim floats
    51→├── rms_final_weight: dim floats
    52→├── q_tokens: [int8 values][float scales] vocab_size × dim (dequantized at load)
    53→├── wq: [int8][scales] per layer
    54→├── wk: [int8][scales] per layer
    55→├── wv: [int8][scales] per layer
    56→├── wo: [int8][scales] per layer
    57→├── w1: [int8][scales] per layer
    58→├── w2: [int8][scales] per layer
    59→├── w3: [int8][scales] per layer
    60→└── wcls: [int8][scales] (or shared with q_tokens)
    61→```
    62→

    92→### Step 2: Create `llm_core.h` - Quantized Structures (Single-Core)
    93→
    94→Simplified header without FreeRTOS dual-core:
    95→
    96→```cpp
    97→#ifndef LLM_CORE_H
    98→#define LLM_CORE_H
    99→
   100→#include <Arduino.h>
   101→#include <SD.h>
   102→
   103→// Global group size for quantization (read from model file)
   104→extern int GS;
   105→
   106→// Quantized tensor (int8 weights + per-group scales)
   107→typedef struct {
   108→    int8_t* q;    // Quantized int8 values
   109→    float* s;     // Scale factors (one per group_size values)
   110→} QuantizedTensor;
   111→
   112→// Model config (read from 256-byte header, adapts to any model size)
   113→typedef struct {
   114→    int dim;
   115→    int hidden_dim;
   116→    int n_layers;
   117→    int n_heads;
   118→    int n_kv_heads;
   119→    int vocab_size;
   120→    int seq_len;
   121→} Config;
   122→
   123→// Quantized transformer weights (from runq.c)
   124→typedef struct {
   125→    // Token embeddings - DEQUANTIZED to fp32 at load time
   126→    QuantizedTensor *q_tokens;
   127→    float* token_embedding_table;  // Dequantized copy
   128→
   129→    // RMS norms - stored as fp32 (NOT quantized)
   130→    float* rms_att_weight;
   131→    float* rms_ffn_weight;
   132→    float* rms_final_weight;
   133→
   134→    // Quantized attention weights (per layer)
   135→    QuantizedTensor *wq;
   136→    QuantizedTensor *wk;
   137→    QuantizedTensor *wv;
   138→    QuantizedTensor *wo;
   139→
   140→    // Quantized FFN weights (per layer)
   141→    QuantizedTensor *w1;
   142→    QuantizedTensor *w2;
   143→    QuantizedTensor *w3;
   144→
   145→    // Quantized classifier
   146→    QuantizedTensor *wcls;
   147→} TransformerWeights;
   148→
   149→// Run state - all sizes allocated dynamically based on Config
   150→typedef struct {
   151→    float *x;       // Current activation (dim)
   152→    float *xb;      // Normalized buffer (dim)
   153→    float *xb2;     // Additional buffer (dim)
   154→    float *hb;      // FFN hidden (hidden_dim)
   155→    float *hb2;     // FFN hidden 2 (hidden_dim)
   156→
   157→    // Quantized activation buffers (for matmul input)
   158→    QuantizedTensor xq;  // Quantized x (dim)
   159→    QuantizedTensor hq;  // Quantized hb (hidden_dim)
   160→
   161→    float *q;       // Query (dim)
   162→    float *k;       // Key (kv_dim)
   163→    float *v;       // Value (kv_dim)
   164→    float *att;     // Attention scores (n_heads × seq_len)
   165→    float *logits;  // Output logits (vocab_size)
   166→
   167→    // KV cache
   168→    float* key_cache;
   169→    float* value_cache;
   170→} RunState;
   171→
   172→// Main transformer
   173→typedef struct {
   174→    Config config;
   175→    TransformerWeights weights;
   176→    RunState state;
   177→    uint8_t* raw_data;       // Raw file data in PSRAM
   178→    size_t file_size;
   179→    uint8_t shared_classifier;
   180→} Transformer;
   181→
   182→// Quantization functions
   183→void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n);
   184→void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n);
   185→
   186→// Core functions
   187→bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path);
   188→void free_transformer(Transformer* t);
   189→
   190→// Neural net operations
   191→void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size);
   192→void softmax(float* x, int size);
   193→void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d);
   194→
   195→// Forward pass
   196→float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos);
   197→
   198→#endif
   199→```
   200→
   201→### Step 3: Create `llm_core.cpp` - Int8 Inference (Single-Core)
   202→
   203→Key sections to implement:
   204→
   205→#### A. Quantization Functions (from runq.c)
   206→
   207→```cpp
   208→int GS = 64;  // Global group size (read from model header)
   209→
   210→void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
   211→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   212→        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
   213→    }
   214→}
   215→
   216→void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
   217→    int num_groups = n / GS;
   218→    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;
   219→
   220→    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
   221→        // Find max absolute value in group
   222→        float wmax = 0.0f;
   223→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
   224→            float val = fabsf(x[group * GS + i]);
   225→            if (val > wmax) wmax = val;
   226→        }
   227→
   228→        // Scale factor
   229→        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
   230→        qx->s[group] = scale;
   231→
   232→        // Quantize
   233→        float inv_scale = (scale != 0.0f) ? 1.0f / scale : 0.0f;
   234→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
   235→            float quant_value = x[group * GS + i] * inv_scale;
   236→            qx->q[group * GS + i] = (int8_t)roundf(quant_value);
   237→        }
   238→    }
   239→}
   240→```
   241→
   242→#### B. Int8 Matrix Multiplication (Single-Core, from runq.c)
   243→
   244→```cpp
   245→// Simple single-threaded int8 matmul
   246→// W (d,n) @ x (n,) -> xout (d,)
   247→void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
   248→    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
   249→        float val = 0.0f;
   250→        int32_t ival = 0;
   251→        int in = i * n;
   252→
   253→        // Process in groups of GS (group size)
   254→        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
   255→            // Accumulate int8 × int8 in int32 (no overflow risk)
   256→            for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
   257→                ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
   258→            }
   259→            // Rescale after each group using float scales
   260→            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
   261→            ival = 0;
   262→        }
   263→        xout[i] = val;
   264→    }
   265→}
   266→```
   267→
   268→#### C. Checkpoint Loading (Version 2 Format, Adaptive to Any Model Size)
   269→
   270→```cpp
   271→bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path) {
   272→    File file = SD.open(checkpoint_path, FILE_READ);
   273→    if (!file) return false;
   274→
   275→    // Read 256-byte header
   276→    uint32_t magic, version;
   277→    file.read((uint8_t*)&magic, 4);
   278→    file.read((uint8_t*)&version, 4);
   279→
   280→    if (magic != 0x616b3432 || version != 2) {
   281→        Serial.println("Invalid Q8_0 model (need magic=0x616b3432, version=2)");
   282→        file.close();
   283→        return false;
   284→    }
   285→
   286→    // Read config (adapts to any model size automatically)
   287→    file.read((uint8_t*)&t->config, sizeof(Config));
   288→
   289→    // Read shared_classifier flag and group_size
   290→    file.read(&t->shared_classifier, 1);
   291→    file.read((uint8_t*)&GS, 4);
   292→
   293→    // Print loaded config (shows any model size works)
   294→    Serial.printf("Model loaded: dim=%d, hidden=%d, layers=%d, heads=%d, vocab=%d, GS=%d\n",
   295→                  t->config.dim, t->config.hidden_dim, t->config.n_layers,
   296→                  t->config.n_heads, t->config.vocab_size, GS);
   297→
   298→    // Load entire file to PSRAM
   299→    t->file_size = file.size();
   300→    t->raw_data = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(t->file_size);
   301→    if (!t->raw_data) {
   302→        Serial.printf("PSRAM allocation failed! Need %zu bytes\n", t->file_size);
   303→        file.close();
   304→        return false;
   305→    }
   306→
   307→    file.seek(0);
   308→    file.read(t->raw_data, t->file_size);
   309→    file.close();
   310→
   311→    Serial.printf("Model file loaded: %.2f MB\n", t->file_size / (1024.0f * 1024.0f));
   312→
   313→    // Memory map weights starting after 256-byte header
   314→    memory_map_weights_q8(&t->weights, &t->config, t->raw_data + 256, t->shared_classifier);
   315→
   316→    // Dequantize token embeddings once (size adapts to vocab_size × dim)
   317→    int emb_size = t->config.vocab_size * t->config.dim;
   318→    t->weights.token_embedding_table = (float*)ps_malloc(emb_size * sizeof(float));
   319→    if (!t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
   320→        Serial.println("Embedding dequant allocation failed!");
   321→        return false;
   322→    }
   323→    dequantize(t->weights.q_tokens, t->weights.token_embedding_table, emb_size);
   324→
   325→    // Allocate run state (sizes based on config, adapts to any model)
   326→    malloc_run_state_q8(&t->state, &t->config);
   327→
   328→    Serial.printf("Free PSRAM after load: %d bytes\n", ESP.getFreePsram());
   329→    return true;
   330→}
   331→```
   332→
   333→#### D. Forward Pass (from runq.c pattern)
   334→
   335→```cpp
   336→float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos) {
   337→    Config* p = &transformer->config;
   338→    TransformerWeights* w = &transformer->weights;
   339→    RunState* s = &transformer->state;
   340→
   341→    int dim = p->dim;
   342→    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
   343→    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
   344→    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;
   345→
   346→    // Copy token embedding (already dequantized)
   347→    memcpy(s->x, w->token_embedding_table + token * dim, dim * sizeof(float));
   348→
   349→    // Forward through layers
   350→    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
   351→        // Attention RMSnorm
   352→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);
   353→
   354→        // Quantize activation, then matmul for Q, K, V
   355→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   356→        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
   357→        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
   358→        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);
   359→
   360→        // RoPE
   361→        // ... (same as stories15m)
   362→
   363→        // Attention
   364→        // ... (same as stories15m, uses fp32 KV cache)
   365→
   366→        // Output projection
   367→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   368→        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);
   369→
   370→        // Residual
   371→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) s->x[i] += s->xb2[i];
   372→
   373→        // FFN RMSnorm
   374→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);
   375→
   376→        // FFN w1, w3
   377→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   378→        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   379→        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   380→
   381→        // SwiGLU
   382→        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i++) {
   383→            float val = s->hb[i];
   384→            val *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-val));
   385→            s->hb[i] = val * s->hb2[i];
   386→        }
   387→
   388→        // FFN w2
   389→        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);
   390→        matmul_q8(s->xb, &s->hq, &w->w2[l], hidden_dim, dim);
   391→
   392→        // Residual
   393→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) s->x[i] += s->xb[i];
   394→    }
   395→
   396→    // Final RMSnorm
   397→    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);
   398→
   399→    // Classifier
   400→    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
   401→    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);
   402→
   403→    return s->logits;
   404→}
   405→```
   406→
   407→### Step 4: Create Main Sketch with SD Card + JSON Config + Prompt Wrapping
   408→
   409→```cpp
   410→#include <SD.h>
   411→#include <SPI.h>
   412→#include <ArduinoJson.h>
   413→#include "llm_core.h"
   414→#include "tokenizer.h"
   415→#include "sampler.h"
   416→
   417→#define SD_CS   41
   418→
   419→// Config structure
   420→struct LLMConfig {
   421→    char model_path[64];
   422→    char tokenizer_path[64];
   423→    float temperature;
   424→    float topp;
   425→    int max_tokens;
   426→};
   427→
   428→LLMConfig config;
   429→Transformer transformer;
   430→Tokenizer tokenizer;
   431→Sampler sampler;
   432→
   433→bool loadConfig(const char* path) {
   434→    File f = SD.open(path);
   435→    if (!f) return false;
   436→
   437→    StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
   438→    if (deserializeJson(doc, f)) {
   439→        f.close();
   440→        return false;
   441→    }
   442→    f.close();
   443→
   444→    strlcpy(config.model_path, doc["model"] | "/models/ajv009_3M_1024TK_q80.bin", 64);
   445→    strlcpy(config.tokenizer_path, doc["tokenizer"] | "/models/ajv009_1024TK.bin", 64);
   446→    config.temperature = doc["temperature"] | 0.8f;
   447→    config.topp = doc["topp"] | 0.9f;
   448→    config.max_tokens = doc["max_tokens"] | 128;
   449→
   450→    return true;
   451→}
   452→
   453→String wrapPrompt(const char* userInput) {
   454→    return String("<|user|>") + userInput + "<|assistant|>";
   455→}
   456→
   457→void generate(const char* prompt, int steps) {
   458→    // Wrap prompt with special tokens
   459→    String wrapped = wrapPrompt(prompt);
   460→
   461→    // Encode
   462→    int* tokens = (int*)malloc((wrapped.length() + 10) * sizeof(int));
   463→    int num_tokens = 0;
   464→    encode(&tokenizer, (char*)wrapped.c_str(), 0, 0, tokens, &num_tokens);
   465→
   466→    // Generate
   467→    int token = tokens[0];
   468→    int pos = 0;
   469→
   470→    while (pos < steps) {
   471→        float* logits = forward(&transformer, token, pos);
   472→        if (!logits) break;
   473→
   474→        int next;
   475→        if (pos < num_tokens - 1) {
   476→            next = tokens[pos + 1];
   477→        } else {
   478→            next = sample(&sampler, logits);
   479→        }
   480→        pos++;
   481→
   482→        // Decode and print
   483→        char* piece = decode(&tokenizer, token, next);
   484→        if (piece) {
   485→            // Check for end token
   486→            if (strstr(piece, "<|end|>")) break;
   487→            Serial.print(piece);
   488→        }
   489→
   490→        token = next;
   491→    }
   492→
   493→    free(tokens);
   494→}
   495→
   496→void setup() {
   497→    Serial.begin(115200);
   498→    delay(1000);
   499→
   500→    Serial.println("\n=== ESP32 Fine-tuned LLM (Q8_0) ===\n");
   501→
   502→    // Init SD
   503→    SPI.begin(39, 40, 38, SD_CS);
   504→    if (!SD.begin(SD_CS)) {
   505→        Serial.println("SD card failed!");
   506→        return;
   507→    }
   508→
   509→    // Load config
   510→    if (!loadConfig("/models/config.json")) {
   511→        Serial.println("Using default config");
   512→    }
   513→
   514→    // Load model
   515→    Serial.printf("Loading model: %s\n", config.model_path);
   516→    if (!build_transformer_q8(&transformer, config.model_path)) {
   517→        Serial.println("Model load failed!");
   518→        return;
   519→    }
   520→
   521→    // Load tokenizer
   522→    if (!build_tokenizer(&tokenizer, config.tokenizer_path, transformer.config.vocab_size)) {
   523→        Serial.println("Tokenizer load failed!");
   524→        return;
   525→    }
   526→
   527→    // Build sampler
   528→    build_sampler(&sampler, transformer.config.vocab_size,
   529→                  config.temperature, config.topp, millis());
   530→
   531→    Serial.println("\nReady! Type your question:");
   532→}
   533→
   534→void loop() {
   535→    if (Serial.available()) {
   536→        String input = Serial.readStringUntil('\n');
   537→        input.trim();
   538→        if (input.length() > 0) {
   539→            Serial.printf("\nQ: %s\nA: ", input.c_str());
   540→            generate(input.c_str(), config.max_tokens);
   541→            Serial.println("\n");
   542→        }
   543→    }
   544→}
   545→```

   568→## Memory Budget (Various Model Sizes)
   569→
   570→All models fit in 8MB PSRAM:
   571→
   572→| Model | File Size | + Embeddings | + KV Cache | + Buffers | **Total** |
   573→|-------|-----------|--------------|------------|-----------|-----------|
   574→| 1M q80 | ~1 MB | ~250 KB | ~130 KB | ~50 KB | **~1.5 MB** |
   575→| 2M q80 | ~2 MB | ~490 KB | ~200 KB | ~80 KB | **~2.8 MB** |
   576→| 3M q80 | ~3 MB | ~700 KB | ~280 KB | ~100 KB | **~4.1 MB** |
   577→| 4M q80 | ~4 MB | ~750 KB | ~300 KB | ~110 KB | **~5.2 MB** |
   578→| 5M q80 | ~5 MB | ~850 KB | ~360 KB | ~130 KB | **~6.4 MB** |
   579→| 6M q80 | ~6 MB | ~920 KB | ~450 KB | ~150 KB | **~7.5 MB** |
   580→
   581→**Conclusion**: Even 6M model fits with ~500KB headroom!

     1→// llm_core.cpp - Int8 Quantized LLM Inference for ESP32-S3
     2→// Based on llama2.c/runq.c - Single-core, adaptive to any model size
     3→
     4→#include "llm_core.h"
     5→#include <math.h>
     6→#include <string.h>
     7→
     8→// Global group size (read from model header, typically 64)
     9→int GS = 64;
    10→
    11→// ============================================================================
    12→// Quantization Functions (from runq.c)
    13→// ============================================================================
    14→
    15→void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    16→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    17→        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
    18→    }
    19→}
    20→
    21→void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    22→    int num_groups = n / GS;
    23→    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;
    24→
    25→    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
    26→        // Find max absolute value in current group
    27→        float wmax = 0.0f;
    28→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
    29→            float val = fabsf(x[group * GS + i]);
    30→            if (val > wmax) wmax = val;
    31→        }
    32→
    33→        // Calculate and store scale factor
    34→        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
    35→        qx->s[group] = scale;
    36→
    37→        // Quantize values in this group
    38→        float inv_scale = (scale != 0.0f) ? 1.0f / scale : 0.0f;
    39→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
    40→            float quant_value = x[group * GS + i] * inv_scale;
    41→            qx->q[group * GS + i] = (int8_t)roundf(quant_value);
    42→        }
    43→    }
    44→}
    45→
    46→// ============================================================================
    47→// Neural Network Operations
    48→// ============================================================================
    49→
    50→void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size) {
    51→    // Calculate sum of squares
    52→    float ss = 0.0f;
    53→    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
    54→        ss += x[j] * x[j];
    55→    }
    56→    ss /= size;
    57→    ss += 1e-5f;
    58→    ss = 1.0f / sqrtf(ss);
    59→
    60→    // Normalize and scale
    61→    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
    62→        o[j] = weight[j] * (ss * x[j]);
    63→    }
    64→}
    65→
    66→void softmax(float* x, int size) {
    67→    // Find max value for numerical stability
    68→    float max_val = x[0];
    69→    for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
    70→        if (x[i] > max_val) max_val = x[i];
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    // Exp and sum
    74→    float sum = 0.0f;
    75→    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    76→        x[i] = expf(x[i] - max_val);
    77→        sum += x[i];
    78→    }
    79→
    80→    // Normalize
    81→    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    82→        x[i] /= sum;
    83→    }
    84→}
    85→
    86→// Int8 quantized matrix multiplication (single-threaded)
    87→// W (d,n) @ x (n,) -> xout (d,)
    88→void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
    89→    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
    90→        float val = 0.0f;
    91→        int32_t ival = 0;
    92→        int in = i * n;
    93→
    94→        // Process in groups of GS
    95→        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
    96→            // Accumulate int8 * int8 in int32 (no overflow risk)
    97→            for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
    98→                ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
    99→            }
   100→            // Rescale after each group using float scales
   101→            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
   102→            ival = 0;
   103→        }
   104→        xout[i] = val;
   105→    }
   106→}

   108→// ============================================================================
   109→// Memory Allocation
   110→// ============================================================================
   111→
   112→static void malloc_run_state(RunState* s, Config* p) {
   113→    int kv_dim = (p->dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
   114→
   115→    // Float activation buffers in PSRAM
   116→    s->x = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   117→    s->xb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   118→    s->xb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   119→    s->hb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
   120→    s->hb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
   121→    s->q = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   122→    s->att = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_heads * p->seq_len, sizeof(float));
   123→    s->logits = (float*)ps_calloc(p->vocab_size, sizeof(float));
   124→
   125→    // KV cache in PSRAM
   126→    s->key_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
   127→    s->value_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
   128→
   129→    // Quantized activation buffers (for matmul input)
   130→    s->xq.q = (int8_t*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(int8_t));
   131→    s->xq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim / GS, sizeof(float));
   132→    s->hq.q = (int8_t*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(int8_t));
   133→    s->hq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim / GS, sizeof(float));
   134→
   135→    // Check allocations
   136→    if (!s->x || !s->xb || !s->xb2 || !s->hb || !s->hb2 || !s->q ||
   137→        !s->att || !s->logits || !s->key_cache || !s->value_cache ||
   138→        !s->xq.q || !s->xq.s || !s->hq.q || !s->hq.s) {
   139→        Serial.println("ERROR: RunState allocation failed!");
   140→    }
   141→}
   142→
   143→static void free_run_state(RunState* s) {
