   160→// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   161→// Neural net blocks
   162→
   163→// TODO: merge these into one function
   164→void copy(tensor1d &dst, tensor1d &src) {
   165→    for (int i = 0; i < dst.size(); i++)  dst[i] = src[i];
   166→}
   167→void copy(tensor2d &dst, tensor2d &src) {
   168→    for (int i = 0; i < dst.size(); i++)  copy(dst[i], src[i]);
   169→}
   170→void copy(tensor3d &dst, tensor3d &src) {
   171→    for (int i = 0; i < dst.size(); i++)  copy(dst[i], src[i]);
   172→}
   173→
   174→void accum(tensor1d &lhs, tensor1d &rhs) {
   175→    for (int i = 0; i < rhs.size(); ++i)  lhs[i] += rhs[i];
   176→}
   177→
   178→void rmsnorm(tensor1d &output, tensor1d &input, tensor1d &weight) {
   179→    float ss = 0.0;
   180→    for (int i = 0; i < input.size(); i++)
   181→        ss += input[i] * input[i];
   182→    ss = ss / input.size() + EPS;
   183→    float inv_ss = 1 / sqrt(ss);
   184→    for (int i = 0; i < input.size(); i++)
   185→        output[i] = input[i] * inv_ss * weight[i];
   186→}
   187→
   188→void softmax(tensor1d &output, tensor1d &input, int max_pos = -1) {
   189→    if (max_pos == -1)  max_pos = input.size();
   190→    float max_val = input[0];
   191→    for (int i = 1; i < max_pos; i++)
   192→        if (input[i] > max_val)  max_val = input[i];
   193→    
   194→    // exp and sum
   195→    float sum = 0;
   196→    for (int i = 0; i < max_pos; i++) {
   197→        output[i] = exp(input[i] - max_val);
   198→        sum += output[i];
   199→    }
   200→    // normalize
   201→    for (int i = 0; i < max_pos; i++)
   202→        output[i] /= sum;
   203→}
   204→
   205→void matmul(tensor1d &output, tensor1d &input, tensor2d &weight) {
   206→    for (int i = 0; i < output.size(); i++) {
   207→        output[i] = 0;
   208→        for (int j = 0; j < input.size(); j++)
   209→            output[i] += input[j] * weight[i][j];
   210→    }
   211→}
   212→
   213→void transformer(int token_index, int token_position, Config &config, RunState &state, TransformerWeights &transformer_weights) {
   214→    // a few convenience variables
   215→    int dim = config.dim;
   216→    int hidden_dim = config.hidden_dim;
   217→    int head_size = dim / config.n_heads;
   218→
   219→    // copy the token embedding into x
   220→    copy(state.x, transformer_weights.token_embedding_table[token_index]);
   221→
   222→    for (int layer = 0; layer < config.n_layers; ++layer) {
   223→        // attention rmsnorm
   224→        rmsnorm(state.xb, state.x, transformer_weights.rms_att_weight[layer]);
   225→
   226→        // attention
   227→        matmul(state.q, state.xb, transformer_weights.wq[layer]);
   228→        matmul(state.k, state.xb, transformer_weights.wk[layer]);
   229→        matmul(state.v, state.xb, transformer_weights.wv[layer]);
   230→
   231→        // apply RoPE positional embeddings
   232→        for (int head = 0; head < config.n_heads; ++head) {
   233→            int start = head * head_size;
   234→            for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i += 2) {
   235→                float q0 = state.q[start + i];
   236→                float q1 = state.q[start + i + 1];
   237→                float k0 = state.k[start + i];
   238→                float k1 = state.k[start + i + 1];
   239→                float fcr = transformer_weights.freq_cis_real[token_position][i / 2];
   240→                float fci = transformer_weights.freq_cis_imag[token_position][i / 2];
   241→                state.q[start + i]     = q0 * fcr - q1 * fci;
   242→                state.q[start + i + 1] = q0 * fci + q1 * fcr;
   243→                state.k[start + i]     = k0 * fcr - k1 * fci;
   244→                state.k[start + i + 1] = k0 * fci + k1 * fcr;
   245→            }
   246→        }
   247→
   248→        // save key/value in cache
   249→        copy(state.key_cache[layer][token_position], state.k);
   250→        copy(state.value_cache[layer][token_position], state.v);
   251→
   252→        // multiquery attention
   253→        for (int head = 0; head < config.n_heads; ++head) {
   254→            for (int timestep = 0; timestep < token_position; ++timestep) {
   255→                float score = 0;
   256→                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; ++i)
   257→                    score += state.q[head * head_size + i] * state.key_cache[layer][timestep][head * head_size + i];
   258→                score /= std::sqrt(head_size * 1.0);
   259→                state.attention[timestep] = score;
   260→            }
   261→
   262→            // softmax
   263→            softmax(state.attention, state.attention, token_position+1);
   264→
   265→            // weighted sum
   266→            for (int i = 0; i < head_size; ++i) {
   267→                state.xb[head * head_size + i] = 0;
   268→                for (int timestep = 0; timestep <= token_position; ++timestep)
   269→                    state.xb[head * head_size + i] += state.attention[timestep] * state.value_cache[layer][timestep][head * head_size + i];
   270→            }
   271→        }
   272→
   273→        // final matmul to get the output of the attention
   274→        matmul(state.xb2, state.xb, transformer_weights.wo[layer]);
   275→
   276→        // residual connection back into x
   277→        accum(state.x, state.xb2);
   278→
   279→        // ffn rmsnorm
   280→        rmsnorm(state.xb, state.x, transformer_weights.rms_ffn_weight[layer]);
   281→
   282→        // Now for FFN in PyTorch we have: self.w2(F.silu(self.w1(x))) * self.w3(x)
   283→        // first calculate self.w1(x) and self.w3(x)
   284→        matmul(state.hb, state.xb, transformer_weights.w1[layer]);
   285→        matmul(state.hb2, state.xb, transformer_weights.w3[layer]);
   286→
   287→        // F.silu; silu(x)=x*σ(x), where σ(x) is the logistic sigmoid
   288→        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; ++i)
   289→            state.hb[i] = state.hb[i] * (1.0 / (1.0 + std::exp(-state.hb[i])));
   290→
   291→        // elementwise multiple with w3(x)
   292→        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; ++i)
   293→            state.hb[i] = state.hb[i] * state.hb2[i];
   294→        
   295→        // final matmul to get the output of the ffn
   296→        matmul(state.xb, state.hb, transformer_weights.w2[layer]);
   297→
   298→        // residual connection
   299→        accum(state.x, state.xb);
   300→    }
   301→
   302→    // final rmsnorm
   303→    rmsnorm(state.x, state.x, transformer_weights.rms_final_weight);
   304→
   305→    // classifier into logits
   306→    matmul(state.logits, state.x, transformer_weights.token_embedding_table);
   307→}

   310→// Utility functions
   311→
   312→int sample(tensor1d &probabilities) {
   313→    std::random_device rd;
   314→    std::mt19937 gen(rd());
   315→    std::uniform_real_distribution<> dis(0, 1);
   316→    float r = dis(gen);
   317→
   318→    float cdf = 0.0;
   319→    for (int i = 0; i < probabilities.size(); ++i) {
   320→        cdf += probabilities[i];
   321→        if (r < cdf)
   322→            return i;
   323→    }
   324→    // in case of rounding errors
   325→    return probabilities.size() - 1;
   326→}
   327→
   328→int argmax(tensor1d &values) {
   329→    int max_i = 0;
   330→    float max_value = values[0];
   331→    for (int i = 1; i < values.size(); ++i)
   332→        if (values[i] > max_value) {
   333→            max_i = i;
   334→            max_value = values[i];
   335→        }
   336→    return max_i;
   337→}

    59→            return false;
    60→        }
    61→        if (file.read((uint8_t*)&len, sizeof(int)) != sizeof(int)) {
    62→            Serial.printf("[TOK] Failed to read len at token %d\n", i);
    63→            file.close();
    64→            return false;
    65→        }
    66→
    67→        // Sanity check len
    68→        if (len < 0 || len > 1000) {
    69→            Serial.printf("[TOK] ERROR: token %d has invalid len=%d\n", i, len);
    70→            file.close();
    71→            return false;
    72→        }
    73→
    74→        t->vocab[i] = (char*)malloc(len + 1);
    75→        if (!t->vocab[i]) {
    76→            Serial.printf("[TOK] malloc failed for token %d (len=%d)\n", i, len);
    77→            file.close();
    78→            return false;
    79→        }
    80→
    81→        if (file.read((uint8_t*)t->vocab[i], len) != len) {
    82→            Serial.printf("[TOK] Failed to read string at token %d\n", i);
    83→            file.close();
    84→            return false;
    85→        }
    86→        t->vocab[i][len] = '\0';
    87→
    88→        // Debug: print first few tokens
    89→        if (i < 5 || i == vocab_size - 1) {
    90→            Serial.printf("[TOK] token[%d] score=%.4f len=%d str='%s'\n",
    91→                          i, t->vocab_scores[i], len, t->vocab[i]);
    92→        }
    93→    }
    94→
    95→    Serial.printf("[TOK] Loaded %d tokens successfully\n", vocab_size);
    96→    file.close();
    97→    return true;

   100→void free_tokenizer(Tokenizer* t) {
   101→    for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
   102→        free(t->vocab[i]);
   103→    }
   104→    free(t->vocab);
   105→    free(t->vocab_scores);
   106→    free(t->sorted_vocab);
   107→}
   108→
   109→char* decode(Tokenizer* t, int prev_token, int token) {
   110→    char* piece = t->vocab[token];
   111→    if (prev_token == 1 && piece[0] == ' ') {
   112→        piece++;
   113→    }
   114→    unsigned char byte_val;
   115→    if (sscanf(piece, "<0x%02hhX>", &byte_val) == 1) {
   116→        piece = (char*)t->byte_pieces + byte_val * 2;
   117→    }
   118→    return piece;
   119→}
   120→
   121→void encode(Tokenizer* t, char* text, int8_t bos, int8_t eos, int* tokens, int* n_tokens) {
   122→    Serial.println("[ENC] ========== ENCODE START ==========");
   123→
   124→    if (text == NULL) {
   125→        Serial.println("[ENC] ERROR: NULL text");
   126→        return;
   127→    }
   128→
   129→    Serial.printf("[ENC] text='%s' (len=%d)\n", text, strlen(text));
   130→    Serial.printf("[ENC] bos=%d, eos=%d\n", bos, eos);
   131→    Serial.printf("[ENC] vocab=%p, vocab_size=%d, max_token_length=%d\n",
   132→                  t->vocab, t->vocab_size, t->max_token_length);
   133→
   134→    // Build sorted_vocab on first call
   135→    if (t->sorted_vocab == NULL) {
   136→        Serial.println("[ENC] Building sorted_vocab (first time)...");
   137→        Serial.printf("[ENC] vocab[0]=%p '%s'\n", t->vocab[0], t->vocab[0]);
   138→        Serial.printf("[ENC] vocab[4]=%p '%s'\n", t->vocab[4], t->vocab[4]);
   139→
   140→        t->sorted_vocab = (TokenIndex*)malloc(t->vocab_size * sizeof(TokenIndex));
   141→        if (!t->sorted_vocab) {
   142→            Serial.println("[ENC] ERROR: sorted_vocab malloc failed!");
   143→            return;
   144→        }
   145→        Serial.printf("[ENC] sorted_vocab allocated at %p (%d bytes)\n",
   146→                      t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size * sizeof(TokenIndex));
   147→
   148→        for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
   149→            t->sorted_vocab[i].str = t->vocab[i];
   150→            t->sorted_vocab[i].id = i;
   151→        }
   152→
   153→        Serial.println("[ENC] Running qsort...");
   154→        qsort(t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size, sizeof(TokenIndex), compare_tokens);
   155→        Serial.println("[ENC] qsort done");
   156→
   157→        // Validate all pointers
   158→        int bad_count = 0;
   159→        for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
   160→            uintptr_t addr = (uintptr_t)t->sorted_vocab[i].str;
   161→            if (addr < 0x3C000000 || addr > 0x3FFFFFFF) {
   162→                if (bad_count < 5) {
   163→                    Serial.printf("[ENC] BAD PTR: sorted_vocab[%d].str=%p id=%d\n",
   164→                                  i, t->sorted_vocab[i].str, t->sorted_vocab[i].id);
   165→                }
   166→                bad_count++;
   167→            }
   168→        }
   169→        if (bad_count > 0) {
   170→            Serial.printf("[ENC] WARNING: %d bad pointers found!\n", bad_count);
   171→        } else {
   172→            Serial.println("[ENC] All pointers valid");
   173→        }
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    // Allocate working buffer
   177→    int buf_size = t->max_token_length * 2 + 3;
   178→    Serial.printf("[ENC] Allocating str_buffer (%d bytes)...\n", buf_size);
   179→    char* str_buffer = (char*)malloc(buf_size);
   180→    if (!str_buffer) {
   181→        Serial.println("[ENC] ERROR: str_buffer malloc failed!");
   182→        return;
   183→    }
   184→    Serial.printf("[ENC] str_buffer=%p\n", str_buffer);
   185→
   186→    size_t str_len = 0;
   187→    *n_tokens = 0;
   188→
   189→    // Add BOS if requested
   190→    if (bos) {
   191→        Serial.println("[ENC] Adding BOS token (id=1)");
   192→        tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 1;
   193→    }
   194→
   195→    // Add space prefix if text not empty
   196→    // SentencePiece uses "▁" (U+2581) for space prefix, not ASCII " "
   197→    if (text[0] != '\0') {
   198→        Serial.println("[ENC] Looking up space prefix...");
   199→        // Try SentencePiece's "▁" first (UTF-8: E2 96 81), then fallback to " "
   200→        int dummy_prefix = str_lookup((char*)"\xE2\x96\x81", t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   201→        if (dummy_prefix < 0) {
   202→            dummy_prefix = str_lookup((char*)" ", t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   203→        }
   204→        Serial.printf("[ENC] Space prefix id=%d\n", dummy_prefix);
   205→        if (dummy_prefix >= 0 && dummy_prefix < t->vocab_size) {
   206→            tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = dummy_prefix;
   207→        } else {
   208→            Serial.printf("[ENC] WARNING: Invalid space prefix %d, skipping\n", dummy_prefix);
   209→        }
   210→    }
   211→
   212→    // Special tokens to detect (must match training)
   213→    const char* special_tokens[] = {"<|user|>", "<|assistant|>", "<|end|>", "<pad>", "<unk>", "<s>", "</s>"};
   214→    const int special_ids[] = {4, 5, 6, 0, 1, 2, 3};  // Their token IDs
   215→    const int num_special = 7;
   216→
   217→    // Tokenize with special token detection
   218→    Serial.println("[ENC] Starting tokenization with special token detection...");
   219→    int char_count = 0;
   220→    char* c = text;
   221→    while (*c != '\0') {
   222→        // First, check for special tokens at current position
   223→        bool found_special = false;
   224→        for (int s = 0; s < num_special; s++) {
   225→            int slen = strlen(special_tokens[s]);
   226→            if (strncmp(c, special_tokens[s], slen) == 0) {
   227→                Serial.printf("[ENC] Found special token '%s' -> id=%d\n", special_tokens[s], special_ids[s]);
   228→                tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = special_ids[s];
   229→                c += slen;
   230→                char_count += slen;
   231→                found_special = true;
   232→                break;
   233→            }
   234→        }
   235→        if (found_special) continue;
   236→
   237→        // Regular character processing
   238→        char_count++;
   239→        if ((*c & 0xC0) != 0x80) {
   240→            str_len = 0;
   241→        }
   242→        str_buffer[str_len++] = *c;
   243→        str_buffer[str_len] = '\0';
   244→        c++;
   245→
   246→        // Continue for UTF-8 multi-byte
   247→        if ((*c & 0xC0) == 0x80 && str_len < 4) {
   248→            continue;
   249→        }
   250→
   251→        int id = str_lookup(str_buffer, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   252→        if (id != -1) {
   253→            tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = id;
   254→        } else {
   255→            // Fallback: try SentencePiece byte tokens like "<0xAB>" or use UNK
   256→            for (int i = 0; i < str_len; i++) {
   257→                char byte_token[8];
   258→                snprintf(byte_token, sizeof(byte_token), "<0x%02X>", (unsigned char)str_buffer[i]);
   259→                int byte_id = str_lookup(byte_token, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   260→                if (byte_id != -1) {
   261→                    tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = byte_id;
   262→                } else {
   263→                    // Use UNK token (id=1) as final fallback
   264→                    tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 1;
   265→                    Serial.printf("[ENC] Unknown byte 0x%02X, using UNK\n", (unsigned char)str_buffer[i]);
   266→                }
   267→            }
   268→        }
   269→        str_len = 0;
   270→    }
   271→    Serial.printf("[ENC] Processed %d chars, got %d initial tokens\n", char_count, *n_tokens);
   272→
   273→    // Print all token IDs
   274→    Serial.print("[ENC] Initial tokens: ");
   275→    for (int i = 0; i < *n_tokens && i < 50; i++) {
   276→        Serial.printf("%d ", tokens[i]);
   277→    }
   278→    if (*n_tokens > 50) Serial.print("...");
   279→    Serial.println();
   280→
   281→    // Validate all token IDs before BPE
   282→    Serial.println("[ENC] Validating token IDs...");
   283→    for (int i = 0; i < *n_tokens; i++) {
   284→        if (tokens[i] < 0 || tokens[i] >= t->vocab_size) {
   285→            Serial.printf("[ENC] INVALID TOKEN: tokens[%d]=%d (vocab_size=%d)\n",
   286→                          i, tokens[i], t->vocab_size);
   287→        }
   288→    }
   289→
   290→    // BPE merge loop
   291→    Serial.println("[ENC] Starting BPE merge loop...");
   292→    int merge_round = 0;
   293→    while (1) {
   294→        merge_round++;
   295→        v4sf best_score = -1e10;
   296→        int best_id = -1;
   297→        int best_idx = -1;
   298→
   299→        for (int i = 0; i < (*n_tokens - 1); i++) {
   300→            int t1 = tokens[i];
   301→            int t2 = tokens[i + 1];
   302→
   303→            // Skip invalid tokens
   304→            if (t1 < 0 || t1 >= t->vocab_size || t2 < 0 || t2 >= t->vocab_size) {
   305→                if (merge_round == 1) {
   306→                    Serial.printf("[ENC] BPE skip invalid: tokens[%d]=%d tokens[%d]=%d\n", i, t1, i+1, t2);
   307→                }
   308→                continue;
   309→            }
   310→
   311→            // Check vocab pointers before sprintf
   312→            if (!t->vocab[t1] || !t->vocab[t2]) {
   313→                Serial.printf("[ENC] NULL vocab ptr: vocab[%d]=%p vocab[%d]=%p\n",
   314→                              t1, t->vocab[t1], t2, t->vocab[t2]);
   315→                continue;
   316→            }
   317→
   318→            sprintf(str_buffer, "%s%s", t->vocab[t1], t->vocab[t2]);
   319→            int id = str_lookup(str_buffer, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   320→            if (id != -1 && t->vocab_scores[id] > best_score) {
   321→                best_score = t->vocab_scores[id];
   322→                best_id = id;
   323→                best_idx = i;
   324→            }
   325→        }
   326→
   327→        if (best_idx == -1) {
   328→            Serial.printf("[ENC] BPE done after %d rounds, final tokens=%d\n", merge_round, *n_tokens);
   329→            break;
   330→        }
   331→
   332→        // Apply merge
   333→        tokens[best_idx] = best_id;
   334→        for (int i = best_idx + 1; i < (*n_tokens - 1); i++) {
   335→            tokens[i] = tokens[i + 1];
   336→        }
   337→        (*n_tokens)--;
   338→
   339→        if (merge_round <= 5 || merge_round % 10 == 0) {
   340→            Serial.printf("[ENC] BPE round %d: merged to id=%d, tokens=%d\n",
   341→                          merge_round, best_id, *n_tokens);
   342→        }
   343→    }
   344→
   345→    // Add EOS if requested
   346→    if (eos) {
   347→        Serial.println("[ENC] Adding EOS token (id=2)");
   348→        tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 2;
   349→    }
   350→
   351→    // Final token list
   352→    Serial.print("[ENC] Final tokens: ");
   353→    for (int i = 0; i < *n_tokens && i < 50; i++) {
   354→        Serial.printf("%d ", tokens[i]);
   355→    }
   356→    if (*n_tokens > 50) Serial.print("...");
   357→    Serial.println();
   358→
   359→    free(str_buffer);
   360→    Serial.println("[ENC] ========== ENCODE DONE ==========");
   361→}

     1→// llm_core.cpp - Int8 Quantized LLM Inference for ESP32-S3
     2→// Based on llama2.c/runq.c - Single-core, adaptive to any model size

     4→#include "llm_core.h"
     5→#include <math.h>

     7→
     8→// Global group size (read from model header, typically 64)
     9→int GS = 64;
    10→
    11→// ============================================================================
    12→// Quantization Functions (from runq.c)
    13→// ============================================================================
    14→
    15→void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    16→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    17→        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
    18→    }
    19→}
    20→
    21→void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    22→    int num_groups = n / GS;
    23→    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;
    24→
    25→    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
    26→        // Find max absolute value in current group
    27→        float wmax = 0.0f;
    28→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
    29→            float val = fabsf(x[group * GS + i]);
    30→            if (val > wmax) wmax = val;
    31→        }
    32→
    33→        // Calculate and store scale factor
    34→        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
    35→        qx->s[group] = scale;
    36→
    37→        // Quantize values in this group
    38→        float inv_scale = (scale != 0.0f) ? 1.0f / scale : 0.0f;
    39→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
    40→            float quant_value = x[group * GS + i] * inv_scale;
    41→            qx->q[group * GS + i] = (int8_t)roundf(quant_value);
    42→        }
    43→    }
    44→}
    45→
    46→// ============================================================================
    47→// Neural Network Operations
    48→// ============================================================================
    49→
    50→void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size) {
    51→    // Calculate sum of squares
    52→    float ss = 0.0f;
    53→    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
    54→        ss += x[j] * x[j];
    55→    }
    56→    ss /= size;
    57→    ss += 1e-5f;
    58→    ss = 1.0f / sqrtf(ss);
    59→
    60→    // Normalize and scale
    61→    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
    62→        o[j] = weight[j] * (ss * x[j]);
    63→    }
    64→}
    65→
    66→void softmax(float* x, int size) {
    67→    // Find max value for numerical stability
    68→    float max_val = x[0];
    69→    for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
    70→        if (x[i] > max_val) max_val = x[i];
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    // Exp and sum
    74→    float sum = 0.0f;
    75→    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    76→        x[i] = expf(x[i] - max_val);
    77→        sum += x[i];
    78→    }
    79→
    80→    // Normalize
    81→    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    82→        x[i] /= sum;
    83→    }
    84→}
    85→
    86→// Int8 quantized matrix multiplication (single-threaded)
    87→// W (d,n) @ x (n,) -> xout (d,)
    88→void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
    89→    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
    90→        float val = 0.0f;
    91→        int32_t ival = 0;
    92→        int in = i * n;
    93→
    94→        // Process in groups of GS
    95→        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
    96→            // Accumulate int8 * int8 in int32 (no overflow risk)
    97→            for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
    98→                ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
    99→            }
   100→            // Rescale after each group using float scales
   101→            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
   102→            ival = 0;
   103→        }
   104→        xout[i] = val;
   105→    }
   106→}

   112→static bool malloc_run_state(RunState* s, Config* p) {
   113→    int kv_dim = (p->dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
   114→
   115→    // Calculate memory needed for RunState
   116→    size_t kv_cache_size = (size_t)p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim * sizeof(float);
   117→    size_t total_needed =
   118→        3 * p->dim * sizeof(float) +           // x, xb, xb2
   119→        2 * p->hidden_dim * sizeof(float) +    // hb, hb2
   120→        p->dim * sizeof(float) +               // q
   121→        p->n_heads * p->seq_len * sizeof(float) + // att
   122→        p->vocab_size * sizeof(float) +        // logits
   123→        2 * kv_cache_size +                    // key_cache, value_cache
   124→        p->dim + p->dim / GS * sizeof(float) + // xq
   125→        p->hidden_dim + p->hidden_dim / GS * sizeof(float); // hq
   126→
   127→    Serial.printf("  RunState needs: %.2f MB (KV cache: %.2f MB)\n",
   128→                  total_needed / (1024.0f * 1024.0f),
   129→                  2 * kv_cache_size / (1024.0f * 1024.0f));
   130→    Serial.printf("  Available PSRAM: %.2f MB\n", ESP.getFreePsram() / (1024.0f * 1024.0f));
   131→
   132→    if (total_needed > ESP.getFreePsram()) {
   133→        Serial.println("ERROR: Not enough PSRAM for RunState!");
   134→        Serial.println("Try a smaller model (3M or less) or reduce max_tokens.");
   135→        return false;
   136→    }
   137→
   138→    // Float activation buffers in PSRAM
   139→    s->x = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   140→    s->xb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   141→    s->xb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   142→    s->hb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
   143→    s->hb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
   144→    s->q = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   145→    s->att = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_heads * p->seq_len, sizeof(float));
   146→    s->logits = (float*)ps_calloc(p->vocab_size, sizeof(float));
   147→
   148→    // KV cache in PSRAM
   149→    s->key_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
   150→    s->value_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
   151→
   152→    // Quantized activation buffers (for matmul input)
   153→    s->xq.q = (int8_t*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(int8_t));
   154→    s->xq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim / GS, sizeof(float));
   155→    s->hq.q = (int8_t*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(int8_t));
   156→    s->hq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim / GS, sizeof(float));
   157→
   158→    // Check allocations
   159→    if (!s->x || !s->xb || !s->xb2 || !s->hb || !s->hb2 || !s->q ||
   160→        !s->att || !s->logits || !s->key_cache || !s->value_cache ||
   161→        !s->xq.q || !s->xq.s || !s->hq.q || !s->hq.s) {
   162→        Serial.println("ERROR: RunState allocation failed!");
   163→        return false;
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    return true;
   167→}

   190→// Initialize n quantized tensors from memory pointer
   191→static QuantizedTensor* init_quantized_tensors(void** ptr, int n, int size_each) {
   192→    void* p = *ptr;
   193→    QuantizedTensor* res = (QuantizedTensor*)malloc(n * sizeof(QuantizedTensor));
   194→
   195→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   196→        // Map quantized int8 values
   197→        res[i].q = (int8_t*)p;
   198→        p = (int8_t*)p + size_each;
   199→
   200→        // Map scale factors (one per group)
   201→        res[i].s = (float*)p;
   202→        p = (float*)p + size_each / GS;
   203→    }
   204→
   205→    *ptr = p;  // Advance pointer
   206→    return res;
   207→}
   208→
   209→static void memory_map_weights(TransformerWeights* w, Config* p, void* ptr, uint8_t shared_classifier) {
   210→    int head_size = p->dim / p->n_heads;
   211→
   212→    // First: fp32 RMS norm weights (NOT quantized)
   213→    float* fptr = (float*)ptr;
   214→    w->rms_att_weight = fptr;
   215→    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
   216→    w->rms_ffn_weight = fptr;
   217→    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
   218→    w->rms_final_weight = fptr;
   219→    fptr += p->dim;
   220→
   221→    // Now quantized weights
   222→    ptr = (void*)fptr;
   223→
   224→    // Token embeddings (quantized, will be dequantized separately)
   225→    w->q_tokens = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->vocab_size * p->dim);
   226→
   227→    // Attention weights per layer
   228→    w->wq = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_heads * head_size));
   229→    w->wk = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
   230→    w->wv = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
   231→    w->wo = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, (p->n_heads * head_size) * p->dim);
   232→
   233→    // FFN weights per layer
   234→    w->w1 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
   235→    w->w2 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->hidden_dim * p->dim);
   236→    w->w3 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
   237→
   238→    // Classifier (shared or separate)
   239→    w->wcls = shared_classifier ? w->q_tokens : init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->dim * p->vocab_size);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// ============================================================================
   243→// Transformer Build/Free
   244→// ============================================================================
   245→
   246→bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path, int max_seq_len) {
   247→    File file = SD.open(checkpoint_path, FILE_READ);
   248→    if (!file) {
   249→        Serial.printf("Failed to open model: %s\n", checkpoint_path);
   250→        return false;
   251→    }
   252→
   253→    // Read 256-byte header
   254→    uint32_t magic, version;
   255→    file.read((uint8_t*)&magic, 4);
   256→    file.read((uint8_t*)&version, 4);
   257→
   258→    // Validate Q8_0 format
   259→    if (magic != 0x616b3432) {
   260→        Serial.printf("Invalid magic: 0x%08X (expected 0x616b3432)\n", magic);
   261→        file.close();
   262→        return false;
   263→    }
   264→    if (version != 2) {
   265→        Serial.printf("Invalid version: %d (expected 2 for Q8_0)\n", version);
   266→        file.close();
   267→        return false;
   268→    }
   269→
   270→    // Read config (adapts to any model size)
   271→    file.read((uint8_t*)&t->config, sizeof(Config));
   272→
   273→    // Read shared_classifier flag and group_size
   274→    file.read(&t->shared_classifier, 1);
   275→    file.read((uint8_t*)&GS, 4);
   276→
   277→    // Override seq_len if requested (to reduce KV cache memory)
   278→    int original_seq_len = t->config.seq_len;
   279→    if (max_seq_len > 0 && max_seq_len < t->config.seq_len) {
   280→        t->config.seq_len = max_seq_len;
   281→        Serial.printf("  seq_len override: %d -> %d (saves KV cache memory)\n",
   282→                      original_seq_len, max_seq_len);
   283→    }
   284→
   285→    // Print loaded config
   286→    Serial.printf("Q8_0 Model loaded:\n");
   287→    Serial.printf("  dim=%d, hidden=%d, layers=%d\n",
   288→                  t->config.dim, t->config.hidden_dim, t->config.n_layers);
   289→    Serial.printf("  heads=%d, kv_heads=%d, vocab=%d, seq=%d\n",
   290→                  t->config.n_heads, t->config.n_kv_heads,
   291→                  t->config.vocab_size, t->config.seq_len);
   292→    Serial.printf("  group_size=%d, shared_cls=%d\n", GS, t->shared_classifier);
   293→
   294→    // Load entire file to PSRAM
   295→    t->file_size = file.size();
   296→    t->raw_data = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(t->file_size);
   297→    if (!t->raw_data) {
   298→        Serial.printf("PSRAM allocation failed! Need %zu bytes\n", t->file_size);
   299→        file.close();
   300→        return false;
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    file.seek(0);
   304→    size_t bytes_read = file.read(t->raw_data, t->file_size);
   305→    file.close();
   306→
   307→    if (bytes_read != t->file_size) {
   308→        Serial.printf("Read error: %zu / %zu bytes\n", bytes_read, t->file_size);
   309→        free(t->raw_data);
   310→        return false;
   311→    }
   312→
   313→    Serial.printf("  File loaded: %.2f MB\n", t->file_size / (1024.0f * 1024.0f));
   314→
   315→    // Memory map weights starting after 256-byte header
   316→    memory_map_weights(&t->weights, &t->config, t->raw_data + 256, t->shared_classifier);
   317→
   318→    // Dequantize token embeddings once (for fast lookup during inference)
   319→    int emb_size = t->config.vocab_size * t->config.dim;
   320→    t->weights.token_embedding_table = (float*)ps_malloc(emb_size * sizeof(float));
   321→    if (!t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
   322→        Serial.println("Embedding allocation failed!");
   323→        free(t->raw_data);
   324→        return false;
   325→    }
   326→
   327→    // Debug: check q_tokens pointers before dequantize
   328→    Serial.printf("  q_tokens: q=%p, s=%p\n", t->weights.q_tokens->q, t->weights.q_tokens->s);
   329→    Serial.printf("  token_embedding_table=%p, emb_size=%d\n", t->weights.token_embedding_table, emb_size);
   330→
   331→    dequantize(t->weights.q_tokens, t->weights.token_embedding_table, emb_size);
   332→
   333→    // Debug: check first few values
   334→    Serial.printf("  First 4 embeddings: %.4f %.4f %.4f %.4f\n",
   335→                  t->weights.token_embedding_table[0],
   336→                  t->weights.token_embedding_table[1],
   337→                  t->weights.token_embedding_table[2],
   338→                  t->weights.token_embedding_table[3]);
   339→
   340→    Serial.printf("  Embeddings dequantized: %.2f KB\n", emb_size * sizeof(float) / 1024.0f);
   341→
   342→    // Allocate run state (sizes based on config)
   343→    if (!malloc_run_state(&t->state, &t->config)) {
   344→        free(t->weights.token_embedding_table);
   345→        free(t->raw_data);
   346→        return false;
   347→    }
   348→
   349→    Serial.printf("  Free PSRAM: %d bytes\n", ESP.getFreePsram());
   350→    Serial.println("Transformer ready!");
   351→
   352→    return true;
   353→}
   354→
   355→void free_transformer(Transformer* t) {
   356→    if (t->raw_data) {
   357→        free(t->raw_data);
   358→        t->raw_data = nullptr;
   359→    }
   360→    if (t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
   361→        free(t->weights.token_embedding_table);
   362→        t->weights.token_embedding_table = nullptr;
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    // Free QuantizedTensor arrays
   366→    free(t->weights.q_tokens);
   367→    free(t->weights.wq);
   368→    free(t->weights.wk);
   369→    free(t->weights.wv);
   370→    free(t->weights.wo);
   371→    free(t->weights.w1);
   372→    free(t->weights.w2);
   373→    free(t->weights.w3);
   374→    if (!t->shared_classifier) {
   375→        free(t->weights.wcls);
   376→    }
   377→
   378→    free_run_state(&t->state);
   379→}

   381→// ============================================================================
   382→// Forward Pass
   383→// ============================================================================
   384→
   385→float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos) {
   386→    Config* p = &transformer->config;
   387→    TransformerWeights* w = &transformer->weights;
   388→    RunState* s = &transformer->state;
   389→
   390→    // Convenience variables
   391→    int dim = p->dim;
   392→    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
   393→    int kv_mul = p->n_heads / p->n_kv_heads;
   394→    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
   395→    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;
   396→
   397→    // Debug: check pointers
   398→    Serial.printf("[FWD] token=%d pos=%d dim=%d\n", token, pos, dim);
   399→    Serial.printf("[FWD] embed_table=%p s->x=%p\n", w->token_embedding_table, s->x);
   400→
   401→    if (token < 0 || token >= p->vocab_size) {
   402→        Serial.printf("[FWD] ERROR: token %d out of range [0, %d)\n", token, p->vocab_size);
   403→        return nullptr;
   404→    }
   405→
   406→    // Copy token embedding into x (already dequantized)
   407→    float* content_row = w->token_embedding_table + token * dim;
   408→    Serial.printf("[FWD] content_row=%p (offset=%d)\n", content_row, token * dim);
   409→    memcpy(s->x, content_row, dim * sizeof(float));
   410→    Serial.println("[FWD] embedding copied OK");
   411→
   412→    // Forward through all layers
   413→    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
   414→        // Attention RMSnorm
   415→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);
   416→
   417→        // QKV matmuls
   418→        int loff = l * p->seq_len * kv_dim;  // KV cache offset for this layer
   419→        s->k = s->key_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
   420→        s->v = s->value_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
   421→
   422→        // Quantize activation, then compute Q, K, V
   423→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   424→        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
   425→        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
   426→        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);
   427→
   428→        // RoPE positional encoding
   429→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i += 2) {
   430→            int head_dim = i % head_size;
   431→            float freq = 1.0f / powf(10000.0f, head_dim / (float)head_size);
   432→            float val = pos * freq;
   433→            float fcr = cosf(val);
   434→            float fci = sinf(val);
   435→            int rotn = i < kv_dim ? 2 : 1;
   436→            for (int v = 0; v < rotn; v++) {
   437→                float* vec = v == 0 ? s->q : s->k;
   438→                float v0 = vec[i];
   439→                float v1 = vec[i + 1];
   440→                vec[i] = v0 * fcr - v1 * fci;
   441→                vec[i + 1] = v0 * fci + v1 * fcr;
   442→            }
   443→        }
   444→
   445→        // Multi-head attention
   446→        for (int h = 0; h < p->n_heads; h++) {
   447→            float* q = s->q + h * head_size;
   448→            float* att = s->att + h * p->seq_len;
   449→
   450→            // Attention scores
   451→            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
   452→                float* k = s->key_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
   453→                float score = 0.0f;
   454→                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
   455→                    score += q[i] * k[i];
   456→                }
   457→                att[t] = score / sqrtf(head_size);
   458→            }
   459→
   460→            // Softmax attention weights
   461→            softmax(att, pos + 1);
   462→
   463→            // Weighted sum of values
   464→            float* xb = s->xb + h * head_size;
   465→            memset(xb, 0, head_size * sizeof(float));
   466→            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
   467→                float* v = s->value_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
   468→                float a = att[t];
   469→                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
   470→                    xb[i] += a * v[i];
   471→                }
   472→            }
   473→        }
   474→
   475→        // Output projection
   476→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   477→        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);
   478→
   479→        // Residual connection
   480→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
   481→            s->x[i] += s->xb2[i];
   482→        }
   483→
   484→        // FFN RMSnorm
   485→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);
   486→
   487→        // FFN: w1 and w3 in parallel, then SwiGLU, then w2
   488→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   489→        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   490→        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   491→
   492→        // SwiGLU activation
   493→        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i++) {
   494→            float val = s->hb[i];
   495→            val *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-val));  // silu(x) = x * sigmoid(x)
   496→            s->hb[i] = val * s->hb2[i];
   497→        }
   498→
   499→        // Down projection
   500→        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);
   501→        matmul_q8(s->xb, &s->hq, &w->w2[l], hidden_dim, dim);
   502→
   503→        // Residual connection
   504→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
   505→            s->x[i] += s->xb[i];
   506→        }
   507→    }
   508→
   509→    // Final RMSnorm
   510→    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);
   511→
   512→    // Classifier into logits
   513→    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
   514→    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);
   515→
   516→    return s->logits;
   517→}

// tokenizer.cpp - BPE Tokenizer implementation

#include "tokenizer.h"
#include <SD.h>

static int compare_tokens(const void* a, const void* b) {
    return strcmp(((TokenIndex*)a)->str, ((TokenIndex*)b)->str);
}

static int str_lookup(char* str, TokenIndex* sorted_vocab, int vocab_size) {
    TokenIndex tok = {.str = str};
    TokenIndex* res = (TokenIndex*)bsearch(&tok, sorted_vocab, vocab_size, sizeof(TokenIndex), compare_tokens);
    return res != NULL ? res->id : -1;
}

bool build_tokenizer(Tokenizer* t, const char* tokenizer_path, int vocab_size) {
    t->vocab_size = vocab_size;
    t->vocab = (char**)malloc(vocab_size * sizeof(char*));
    t->vocab_scores = (v4sf*)malloc(vocab_size * sizeof(v4sf));
    t->sorted_vocab = NULL;

    if (!t->vocab || !t->vocab_scores) {
        Serial.println("Tokenizer allocation failed!");
        return false;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        t->byte_pieces[i * 2] = (unsigned char)i;
        t->byte_pieces[i * 2 + 1] = '\0';
    }

    File file = SD.open(tokenizer_path, FILE_READ);
    if (!file) {
        Serial.printf("Failed to open tokenizer: %s\n", tokenizer_path);
        return false;
    }

    if (file.read((uint8_t*)&t->max_token_length, sizeof(int)) != sizeof(int)) {
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    if (t->max_token_length <= 0 || t->max_token_length > 1000) {
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    int len;
    for (int i = 0; i < vocab_size; i++) {
        if (file.read((uint8_t*)(t->vocab_scores + i), sizeof(v4sf)) != sizeof(v4sf)) {
            file.close();
            return false;
        }
        if (file.read((uint8_t*)&len, sizeof(int)) != sizeof(int)) {
            file.close();
            return false;
        }

        if (len < 0 || len > 1000) {
            file.close();
            return false;
        }

        t->vocab[i] = (char*)malloc(len + 1);
        if (!t->vocab[i]) {
            file.close();
            return false;
        }

        if (file.read((uint8_t*)t->vocab[i], len) != len) {
            file.close();
            return false;
        }
        t->vocab[i][len] = '\0';
    }

    file.close();
    return true;
}

void free_tokenizer(Tokenizer* t) {
    for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
        free(t->vocab[i]);
    }
    free(t->vocab);
    free(t->vocab_scores);
    free(t->sorted_vocab);
}

char* decode(Tokenizer* t, int prev_token, int token) {
    char* piece = t->vocab[token];
    if (prev_token == 1 && piece[0] == ' ') {
        piece++;
    }
    unsigned char byte_val;
    if (sscanf(piece, "<0x%02hhX>", &byte_val) == 1) {
        piece = (char*)t->byte_pieces + byte_val * 2;
    }
    return piece;
}

void encode(Tokenizer* t, char* text, int8_t bos, int8_t eos, int* tokens, int* n_tokens) {
    if (text == NULL) return;

    // Build sorted_vocab on first call
    if (t->sorted_vocab == NULL) {
        t->sorted_vocab = (TokenIndex*)malloc(t->vocab_size * sizeof(TokenIndex));
        if (!t->sorted_vocab) return;

        for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
            t->sorted_vocab[i].str = t->vocab[i];
            t->sorted_vocab[i].id = i;
        }
        qsort(t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size, sizeof(TokenIndex), compare_tokens);
    }

    // Allocate working buffer
    int buf_size = t->max_token_length * 2 + 3;
    char* str_buffer = (char*)malloc(buf_size);
    if (!str_buffer) return;

    size_t str_len = 0;
    *n_tokens = 0;

    // Add BOS if requested
    if (bos) {
        tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 1;
    }

    // Add space prefix if text not empty
    // SentencePiece uses "▁" (U+2581) for space prefix, not ASCII " "
    if (text[0] != '\0') {
        int dummy_prefix = str_lookup((char*)"\xE2\x96\x81", t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
        if (dummy_prefix < 0) {
            dummy_prefix = str_lookup((char*)" ", t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
        }
        if (dummy_prefix >= 0 && dummy_prefix < t->vocab_size) {
            tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = dummy_prefix;
        }
    }

    // Special tokens to detect (must match training)
    const char* special_tokens[] = {"<|user|>", "<|assistant|>", "<|end|>", "<pad>", "<unk>", "<s>", "</s>"};
    const int special_ids[] = {4, 5, 6, 0, 1, 2, 3};
    const int num_special = 7;

    // Tokenize with special token detection
    char* c = text;
    while (*c != '\0') {
        // Check for special tokens at current position
        bool found_special = false;
        for (int s = 0; s < num_special; s++) {
            int slen = strlen(special_tokens[s]);
            if (strncmp(c, special_tokens[s], slen) == 0) {
                tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = special_ids[s];
                c += slen;
                found_special = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (found_special) continue;

        // Regular character processing
        if ((*c & 0xC0) != 0x80) {
            str_len = 0;
        }
        str_buffer[str_len++] = *c;
        str_buffer[str_len] = '\0';
        c++;

        // Continue for UTF-8 multi-byte
        if ((*c & 0xC0) == 0x80 && str_len < 4) {
            continue;
        }

        int id = str_lookup(str_buffer, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
        if (id != -1) {
            tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = id;
        } else {
            // Fallback: try SentencePiece byte tokens like "<0xAB>" or use UNK
            for (int i = 0; i < str_len; i++) {
                char byte_token[8];
                snprintf(byte_token, sizeof(byte_token), "<0x%02X>", (unsigned char)str_buffer[i]);
                int byte_id = str_lookup(byte_token, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
                if (byte_id != -1) {
                    tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = byte_id;
                } else {
                    tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 1;  // UNK token
                }
            }
        }
        str_len = 0;
    }

    // BPE merge loop
    while (1) {
        v4sf best_score = -1e10;
        int best_id = -1;
        int best_idx = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < (*n_tokens - 1); i++) {
            int t1 = tokens[i];
            int t2 = tokens[i + 1];

            if (t1 < 0 || t1 >= t->vocab_size || t2 < 0 || t2 >= t->vocab_size) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!t->vocab[t1] || !t->vocab[t2]) {
                continue;
            }

            sprintf(str_buffer, "%s%s", t->vocab[t1], t->vocab[t2]);
            int id = str_lookup(str_buffer, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
            if (id != -1 && t->vocab_scores[id] > best_score) {
                best_score = t->vocab_scores[id];
                best_id = id;
                best_idx = i;
            }
        }

        if (best_idx == -1) break;

        // Apply merge
        tokens[best_idx] = best_id;
        for (int i = best_idx + 1; i < (*n_tokens - 1); i++) {
            tokens[i] = tokens[i + 1];
        }
        (*n_tokens)--;
    }

    // Add EOS if requested
    if (eos) {
        tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 2;
    }

    free(str_buffer);
}

// llm_core.cpp - Int8 Quantized LLM Inference for ESP32-S3
// Based on llama2.c/runq.c - Single-core, adaptive to any model size

#include "llm_core.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

// Global group size (read from model header, typically 32 or 64)
int GS = 64;

// ============================================================================
// Quantization Functions
// ============================================================================

void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
    }
}

void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    int num_groups = n / GS;
    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;

    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
        float wmax = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
            float val = fabsf(x[group * GS + i]);
            if (val > wmax) wmax = val;
        }

        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
        qx->s[group] = scale;

        float inv_scale = (scale != 0.0f) ? 1.0f / scale : 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
            float quant_value = x[group * GS + i] * inv_scale;
            qx->q[group * GS + i] = (int8_t)roundf(quant_value);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Neural Network Operations
// ============================================================================

void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size) {
    float ss = 0.0f;
    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
        ss += x[j] * x[j];
    }
    ss /= size;
    ss += 1e-5f;
    ss = 1.0f / sqrtf(ss);

    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
        o[j] = weight[j] * (ss * x[j]);
    }
}

void softmax(float* x, int size) {
    float max_val = x[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
        if (x[i] > max_val) max_val = x[i];
    }

    float sum = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        x[i] = expf(x[i] - max_val);
        sum += x[i];
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        x[i] /= sum;
    }
}

void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
        float val = 0.0f;
        int32_t ival = 0;
        int in = i * n;

        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
            for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
                ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
            }
            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
            ival = 0;
        }
        xout[i] = val;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Memory Allocation
// ============================================================================

static bool malloc_run_state(RunState* s, Config* p) {
    int kv_dim = (p->dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;

    size_t kv_cache_size = (size_t)p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim * sizeof(float);
    size_t total_needed =
        3 * p->dim * sizeof(float) +
        2 * p->hidden_dim * sizeof(float) +
        p->dim * sizeof(float) +
        p->n_heads * p->seq_len * sizeof(float) +
        p->vocab_size * sizeof(float) +
        2 * kv_cache_size +
        p->dim + p->dim / GS * sizeof(float) +
        p->hidden_dim + p->hidden_dim / GS * sizeof(float);

    if (total_needed > ESP.getFreePsram()) {
        Serial.println("ERROR: Not enough PSRAM for RunState!");
        return false;
    }

    s->x = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->xb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->xb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->hb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->hb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->q = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->att = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_heads * p->seq_len, sizeof(float));
    s->logits = (float*)ps_calloc(p->vocab_size, sizeof(float));

    s->key_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->value_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));

    s->xq.q = (int8_t*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(int8_t));
    s->xq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim / GS, sizeof(float));
    s->hq.q = (int8_t*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(int8_t));
    s->hq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim / GS, sizeof(float));

    if (!s->x || !s->xb || !s->xb2 || !s->hb || !s->hb2 || !s->q ||
        !s->att || !s->logits || !s->key_cache || !s->value_cache ||
        !s->xq.q || !s->xq.s || !s->hq.q || !s->hq.s) {
        Serial.println("ERROR: RunState allocation failed!");
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

static void free_run_state(RunState* s) {
    free(s->x);
    free(s->xb);
    free(s->xb2);
    free(s->hb);
    free(s->hb2);
    free(s->q);
    free(s->att);
    free(s->logits);
    free(s->key_cache);
    free(s->value_cache);
    free(s->xq.q);
    free(s->xq.s);
    free(s->hq.q);
    free(s->hq.s);
}

// ============================================================================
// Weight Memory Mapping (Q8_0 Format)
// ============================================================================

static QuantizedTensor* init_quantized_tensors(void** ptr, int n, int size_each) {
    void* p = *ptr;
    QuantizedTensor* res = (QuantizedTensor*)malloc(n * sizeof(QuantizedTensor));

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        res[i].q = (int8_t*)p;
        p = (int8_t*)p + size_each;
        res[i].s = (float*)p;
        p = (float*)p + size_each / GS;
    }

    *ptr = p;
    return res;
}

static void memory_map_weights(TransformerWeights* w, Config* p, void* ptr, uint8_t shared_classifier) {
    int head_size = p->dim / p->n_heads;

    float* fptr = (float*)ptr;
    w->rms_att_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
    w->rms_ffn_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
    w->rms_final_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->dim;

    ptr = (void*)fptr;

    w->q_tokens = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->vocab_size * p->dim);
    w->wq = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_heads * head_size));
    w->wk = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
    w->wv = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
    w->wo = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, (p->n_heads * head_size) * p->dim);
    w->w1 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
    w->w2 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->hidden_dim * p->dim);
    w->w3 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
    w->wcls = shared_classifier ? w->q_tokens : init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->dim * p->vocab_size);
}

// ============================================================================
// Transformer Build/Free
// ============================================================================

bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path, int max_seq_len) {
    File file = SD.open(checkpoint_path, FILE_READ);
    if (!file) {
        Serial.printf("Failed to open model: %s\n", checkpoint_path);
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t magic, version;
    file.read((uint8_t*)&magic, 4);
    file.read((uint8_t*)&version, 4);

    if (magic != 0x616b3432) {
        Serial.printf("Invalid magic: 0x%08X\n", magic);
        file.close();
        return false;
    }
    if (version != 2) {
        Serial.printf("Invalid version: %d\n", version);
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    file.read((uint8_t*)&t->config, sizeof(Config));
    file.read(&t->shared_classifier, 1);
    file.read((uint8_t*)&GS, 4);

    if (max_seq_len > 0 && max_seq_len < t->config.seq_len) {
        t->config.seq_len = max_seq_len;
    }

    Serial.printf("Model: dim=%d, layers=%d, vocab=%d, seq=%d\n",
                  t->config.dim, t->config.n_layers,
                  t->config.vocab_size, t->config.seq_len);

    t->file_size = file.size();
    t->raw_data = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(t->file_size);
    if (!t->raw_data) {
        Serial.println("PSRAM allocation failed!");
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    file.seek(0);
    size_t bytes_read = file.read(t->raw_data, t->file_size);
    file.close();

    if (bytes_read != t->file_size) {
        free(t->raw_data);
        return false;
    }

    memory_map_weights(&t->weights, &t->config, t->raw_data + 256, t->shared_classifier);

    int emb_size = t->config.vocab_size * t->config.dim;
    t->weights.token_embedding_table = (float*)ps_malloc(emb_size * sizeof(float));
    if (!t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
        Serial.println("Embedding allocation failed!");
        free(t->raw_data);
        return false;
    }

    dequantize(t->weights.q_tokens, t->weights.token_embedding_table, emb_size);

    if (!malloc_run_state(&t->state, &t->config)) {
        free(t->weights.token_embedding_table);
        free(t->raw_data);
        return false;
    }

    Serial.println("Model ready!");
    return true;
}

void free_transformer(Transformer* t) {
    if (t->raw_data) {
        free(t->raw_data);
        t->raw_data = nullptr;
    }
    if (t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
        free(t->weights.token_embedding_table);
        t->weights.token_embedding_table = nullptr;
    }

    free(t->weights.q_tokens);
    free(t->weights.wq);
    free(t->weights.wk);
    free(t->weights.wv);
    free(t->weights.wo);
    free(t->weights.w1);
    free(t->weights.w2);
    free(t->weights.w3);
    if (!t->shared_classifier) {
        free(t->weights.wcls);
    }

    free_run_state(&t->state);
}

// ============================================================================
// Forward Pass
// ============================================================================

float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos) {
    Config* p = &transformer->config;
    TransformerWeights* w = &transformer->weights;
    RunState* s = &transformer->state;

    int dim = p->dim;
    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
    int kv_mul = p->n_heads / p->n_kv_heads;
    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;

    if (token < 0 || token >= p->vocab_size) {
        return nullptr;
    }

    // Copy token embedding
    float* content_row = w->token_embedding_table + token * dim;
    memcpy(s->x, content_row, dim * sizeof(float));

    // Forward through all layers
    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);

        int loff = l * p->seq_len * kv_dim;
        s->k = s->key_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
        s->v = s->value_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;

        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);

        // RoPE
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i += 2) {
            int head_dim = i % head_size;
            float freq = 1.0f / powf(10000.0f, head_dim / (float)head_size);
            float val = pos * freq;
            float fcr = cosf(val);
            float fci = sinf(val);
            int rotn = i < kv_dim ? 2 : 1;
            for (int v = 0; v < rotn; v++) {
                float* vec = v == 0 ? s->q : s->k;
                float v0 = vec[i];
                float v1 = vec[i + 1];
                vec[i] = v0 * fcr - v1 * fci;
                vec[i + 1] = v0 * fci + v1 * fcr;
            }
        }

        // Multi-head attention
        for (int h = 0; h < p->n_heads; h++) {
            float* q = s->q + h * head_size;
            float* att = s->att + h * p->seq_len;

            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
                float* k = s->key_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
                float score = 0.0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
                    score += q[i] * k[i];
                }
                att[t] = score / sqrtf(head_size);
            }

            softmax(att, pos + 1);

            float* xb = s->xb + h * head_size;
            memset(xb, 0, head_size * sizeof(float));
            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
                float* v = s->value_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
                float a = att[t];
                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
                    xb[i] += a * v[i];
                }
            }
        }

        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);

        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            s->x[i] += s->xb2[i];
        }

        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);

        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);

        // SwiGLU
        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i++) {
            float val = s->hb[i];
            val *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-val));
            s->hb[i] = val * s->hb2[i];
        }

        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->xb, &s->hq, &w->w2[l], hidden_dim, dim);

        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            s->x[i] += s->xb[i];
        }
    }

    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);

    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);

    return s->logits;
}

   307→// ============================================================================
   308→// Forward Pass
   309→// ============================================================================
   310→
   311→float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos) {
   312→    Config* p = &transformer->config;
   313→    TransformerWeights* w = &transformer->weights;
   314→    RunState* s = &transformer->state;
   315→
   316→    int dim = p->dim;
   317→    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
   318→    int kv_mul = p->n_heads / p->n_kv_heads;
   319→    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
   320→    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;
   321→
   322→    if (token < 0 || token >= p->vocab_size) {
   323→        return nullptr;
   324→    }
   325→
   326→    // Copy token embedding
   327→    float* content_row = w->token_embedding_table + token * dim;
   328→    memcpy(s->x, content_row, dim * sizeof(float));
   329→
   330→    // Forward through all layers
   331→    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
   332→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);
   333→
   334→        int loff = l * p->seq_len * kv_dim;
   335→        s->k = s->key_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
   336→        s->v = s->value_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
   337→
   338→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   339→        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
   340→        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
   341→        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);
   342→
   343→        // RoPE
   344→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i += 2) {
   345→            int head_dim = i % head_size;
   346→            float freq = 1.0f / powf(10000.0f, head_dim / (float)head_size);
   347→            float val = pos * freq;
   348→            float fcr = cosf(val);
   349→            float fci = sinf(val);
   350→            int rotn = i < kv_dim ? 2 : 1;
   351→            for (int v = 0; v < rotn; v++) {
   352→                float* vec = v == 0 ? s->q : s->k;
   353→                float v0 = vec[i];
   354→                float v1 = vec[i + 1];
   355→                vec[i] = v0 * fcr - v1 * fci;
   356→                vec[i + 1] = v0 * fci + v1 * fcr;
   357→            }
   358→        }
   359→
   360→        // Multi-head attention
   361→        for (int h = 0; h < p->n_heads; h++) {
   362→            float* q = s->q + h * head_size;
   363→            float* att = s->att + h * p->seq_len;
   364→
   365→            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
   366→                float* k = s->key_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
   367→                float score = 0.0f;
   368→                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
   369→                    score += q[i] * k[i];
   370→                }
   371→                att[t] = score / sqrtf(head_size);
   372→            }
   373→
   374→            softmax(att, pos + 1);
   375→
   376→            float* xb = s->xb + h * head_size;
   377→            memset(xb, 0, head_size * sizeof(float));
   378→            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
   379→                float* v = s->value_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
   380→                float a = att[t];
   381→                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
   382→                    xb[i] += a * v[i];
   383→                }
   384→            }
   385→        }
   386→
   387→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   388→        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);
   389→
   390→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
   391→            s->x[i] += s->xb2[i];
   392→        }
   393→
   394→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);
   395→
   396→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   397→        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   398→        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   399→
   400→        // SwiGLU
   401→        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i++) {
   402→            float val = s->hb[i];
   403→            val *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-val));
   404→            s->hb[i] = val * s->hb2[i];
   405→        }
   406→
   407→        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);
   408→        matmul_q8(s->xb, &s->hq, &w->w2[l], hidden_dim, dim);
   409→
   410→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
   411→            s->x[i] += s->xb[i];
   412→        }
   413→    }
   414→
   415→    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);
   416→
   417→    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
   418→    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);
   419→
   420→    return s->logits;
   421→}

    11→// ============================================================================
    12→// Quantization Functions
    13→// ============================================================================
    14→
    15→void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    16→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    17→        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
    18→    }
    19→}
    20→
    21→void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    22→    int num_groups = n / GS;
    23→    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;
    24→
    25→    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
    26→        float wmax = 0.0f;
    27→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
    28→            float val = fabsf(x[group * GS + i]);
    29→            if (val > wmax) wmax = val;
    30→        }
    31→
    32→        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
    33→        qx->s[group] = scale;
    34→
    35→        float inv_scale = (scale != 0.0f) ? 1.0f / scale : 0.0f;
    36→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
    37→            float quant_value = x[group * GS + i] * inv_scale;
    38→            qx->q[group * GS + i] = (int8_t)roundf(quant_value);
    39→        }
    40→    }
    41→}
    42→
    43→// ============================================================================
    44→// Neural Network Operations
    45→// ============================================================================
    46→
    47→void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size) {
    48→    float ss = 0.0f;
    49→    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
    50→        ss += x[j] * x[j];
    51→    }
    52→    ss /= size;
    53→    ss += 1e-5f;
    54→    ss = 1.0f / sqrtf(ss);
    55→
    56→    for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
    57→        o[j] = weight[j] * (ss * x[j]);
    58→    }
    59→}
    60→
    61→void softmax(float* x, int size) {
    62→    float max_val = x[0];
    63→    for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
    64→        if (x[i] > max_val) max_val = x[i];
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    float sum = 0.0f;
    68→    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    69→        x[i] = expf(x[i] - max_val);
    70→        sum += x[i];
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    74→        x[i] /= sum;
    75→    }
    76→}
    77→
    78→void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
    79→    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
    80→        float val = 0.0f;
    81→        int32_t ival = 0;
    82→        int in = i * n;
    83→
    84→        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
    85→            for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
    86→                ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
    87→            }
    88→            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
    89→            ival = 0;
    90→        }
    91→        xout[i] = val;
    92→    }
    93→}

   165→
   166→static QuantizedTensor* init_quantized_tensors(void** ptr, int n, int size_each) {
   167→    void* p = *ptr;
   168→    QuantizedTensor* res = (QuantizedTensor*)malloc(n * sizeof(QuantizedTensor));
   169→
   170→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   171→        res[i].q = (int8_t*)p;
   172→        p = (int8_t*)p + size_each;
   173→        res[i].s = (float*)p;
   174→        p = (float*)p + size_each / GS;
   175→    }
   176→
   177→    *ptr = p;
   178→    return res;
   179→}
   180→
   181→static void memory_map_weights(TransformerWeights* w, Config* p, void* ptr, uint8_t shared_classifier) {
   182→    int head_size = p->dim / p->n_heads;
   183→
   184→    float* fptr = (float*)ptr;
   185→    w->rms_att_weight = fptr;
   186→    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
   187→    w->rms_ffn_weight = fptr;
   188→    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
   189→    w->rms_final_weight = fptr;
   190→    fptr += p->dim;
   191→
   192→    ptr = (void*)fptr;
   193→
   194→    w->q_tokens = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->vocab_size * p->dim);
   195→    w->wq = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_heads * head_size));
   196→    w->wk = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
   197→    w->wv = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
   198→    w->wo = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, (p->n_heads * head_size) * p->dim);
   199→    w->w1 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
   200→    w->w2 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->hidden_dim * p->dim);
   201→    w->w3 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
   202→    w->wcls = shared_classifier ? w->q_tokens : init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->dim * p->vocab_size);
   203→}

   242→
   243→    t->file_size = file.size();

   280→}

   307→// ============================================================================
   308→// Forward Pass
   309→// ============================================================================
   310→
   311→float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos) {
   312→    Config* p = &transformer->config;
   313→    TransformerWeights* w = &transformer->weights;
   314→    RunState* s = &transformer->state;
   315→
   316→    int dim = p->dim;
   317→    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
   318→    int kv_mul = p->n_heads / p->n_kv_heads;
   319→    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
   320→    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;
   321→
   322→    if (token < 0 || token >= p->vocab_size) {
   323→        return nullptr;
   324→    }
   325→
   326→    // Copy token embedding
   327→    float* content_row = w->token_embedding_table + token * dim;
   328→    memcpy(s->x, content_row, dim * sizeof(float));
   329→
   330→    // Forward through all layers
   331→    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
   332→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);
   333→
   334→        int loff = l * p->seq_len * kv_dim;
   335→        s->k = s->key_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
   336→        s->v = s->value_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
   337→
   338→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   339→        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
   340→        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
   341→        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);
   342→
   343→        // RoPE
   344→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i += 2) {
   345→            int head_dim = i % head_size;
   346→            float freq = 1.0f / powf(10000.0f, head_dim / (float)head_size);
   347→            float val = pos * freq;
   348→            float fcr = cosf(val);
   349→            float fci = sinf(val);
   350→            int rotn = i < kv_dim ? 2 : 1;
   351→            for (int v = 0; v < rotn; v++) {
   352→                float* vec = v == 0 ? s->q : s->k;
   353→                float v0 = vec[i];
   354→                float v1 = vec[i + 1];
   355→                vec[i] = v0 * fcr - v1 * fci;
   356→                vec[i + 1] = v0 * fci + v1 * fcr;
   357→            }
   358→        }
   359→
   360→        // Multi-head attention
   361→        for (int h = 0; h < p->n_heads; h++) {
   362→            float* q = s->q + h * head_size;
   363→            float* att = s->att + h * p->seq_len;
   364→
   365→            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
   366→                float* k = s->key_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
   367→                float score = 0.0f;
   368→                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {

   370→                }
   371→                att[t] = score / sqrtf(head_size);
   372→            }
   373→
   374→            softmax(att, pos + 1);
   375→
   376→            float* xb = s->xb + h * head_size;
   377→            memset(xb, 0, head_size * sizeof(float));
   378→            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
   379→                float* v = s->value_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
   380→                float a = att[t];
   381→                for (int i = 0; i < head_size; i++) {
   382→                    xb[i] += a * v[i];
   383→                }
   384→            }
   385→        }
   386→
   387→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   388→        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);
   389→
   390→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
   391→            s->x[i] += s->xb2[i];
   392→        }
   393→
   394→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);
   395→
   396→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   397→        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   398→        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   399→
   400→        // SwiGLU
   401→        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i++) {

   407→        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);

   409→
   410→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {

   412→        }
   413→    }
   414→
   415→    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);
   416→
   417→    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
   418→    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);
   419→
   420→    return s->logits;
   421→}

   201→### Step 3: Create `llm_core.cpp` - Int8 Inference (Single-Core)

   204→
   205→#### A. Quantization Functions (from runq.c)
   206→
   207→```cpp
   208→int GS = 64;  // Global group size (read from model header)
   209→
   210→void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
   211→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   212→        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
   213→    }
   214→}
   215→
   216→void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
   217→    int num_groups = n / GS;
   218→    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;
   219→
   220→    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
   221→        // Find max absolute value in group
   222→        float wmax = 0.0f;
   223→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
   224→            float val = fabsf(x[group * GS + i]);
   225→            if (val > wmax) wmax = val;
   226→        }
   227→
   228→        // Scale factor
   229→        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
   230→        qx->s[group] = scale;
   231→
   232→        // Quantize
   233→        float inv_scale = (scale != 0.0f) ? 1.0f / scale : 0.0f;
   234→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) {
   235→            float quant_value = x[group * GS + i] * inv_scale;
   236→            qx->q[group * GS + i] = (int8_t)roundf(quant_value);
   237→        }
   238→    }
   239→}
   240→```
   241→
   242→#### B. Int8 Matrix Multiplication (Single-Core, from runq.c)
   243→
   244→```cpp
   245→// Simple single-threaded int8 matmul
   246→// W (d,n) @ x (n,) -> xout (d,)
   247→void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
   248→    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
   249→        float val = 0.0f;
   250→        int32_t ival = 0;
   251→        int in = i * n;
   252→
   253→        // Process in groups of GS (group size)
   254→        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
   255→            // Accumulate int8 × int8 in int32 (no overflow risk)
   256→            for (int k = 0; k < GS; k++) {
   257→                ival += (int32_t)x->q[j + k] * (int32_t)w->q[in + j + k];
   258→            }
   259→            // Rescale after each group using float scales
   260→            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
   261→            ival = 0;
   262→        }
   263→        xout[i] = val;
   264→    }
   265→}
   266→```
